## Neighborhoods he works in (each page: satellite map, photos, places, rules, FAQ)

- [Malibu](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu): Twenty-one miles of coast, its own city, and septic tanks. City of Malibu, ZIP 90265.
- [Marina del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey): Boats, high-rises and the bike path, run by the county. Unincorporated LA County, ZIP 90292.
- [Pacific Palisades](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/pacific-palisades): A beach town in the hills, rebuilding after the January 2025 fire. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90272.
- [Playa Vista](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-vista): A planned neighborhood with a park every few blocks. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90094.
- [Playa del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-del-rey): The quiet beach town most of LA forgets about. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90293.
- [Santa Monica](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica): The beach city with its own rules, its own schools and a train to Downtown. City of Santa Monica, ZIP 90401, 90402, 90403, 90404, 90405.
- [Venice](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice): Abbot Kinney, the canals and the boardwalk, inside the City of LA. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90291.
- [Brentwood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/brentwood): Big lots, big trees, and the San Vicente coral trees. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90049.
- [Century City](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/century-city): High-rise living on the old 20th Century Fox backlot. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90067.
- [Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/cheviot-hills): Curving streets next to the best public park on the Westside. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90064.
- [Culver City](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/culver-city): Its own city, its own schools, and a downtown that works. City of Culver City, ZIP 90230, 90232.
- [Mar Vista](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/mar-vista): Westside residential streets and mid-century homes, minutes from the beach. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90066.
- [Palms](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/palms): Dense, central and close to everything. The Westside's renter neighborhood. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90034.
- [Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/pico-robertson): Walkable, next to Beverly Hills, anchored by Pico Boulevard. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90035.
- [West LA & Sawtelle](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/west-la): Sawtelle Japantown and the Westside's best casual food. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90025.
- [Westchester](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westchester): Post-war houses, real yards, and LMU on the bluff. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90045.
- [Westwood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westwood): UCLA, Westwood Village and the Wilshire Corridor towers. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90024.
- [Bel Air](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/bel-air): Gated entrances, estate lots and the biggest houses in LA. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90077.
- [Beverly Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/beverly-hills): Its own city, its own schools, its own police, and the Flats. City of Beverly Hills, ZIP 90210, 90211, 90212.
- [Beverly Hills Post Office](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/bhpo): A 90210 address in the City of LA. Canyons, views and privacy. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90210.
- [Hollywood Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hollywood-hills): City views five minutes from Sunset. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90068, 90046, 90069.
- [Beverly Grove](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/beverly-grove): Third Street, the Beverly Center and Spanish duplexes on every block. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90048.
- [Fairfax District](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/fairfax): The Original Farmers Market, The Grove and blocks of Spanish duplexes. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90036.
- [Hancock Park & Larchmont](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hancock-park): Old LA mansions, Larchmont Village and the Wilshire Country Club. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90004, 90020.
- [Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hollywood): Studios, nightlife and the B Line. Live a few blocks off the boulevard. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90028, 90038.
- [Miracle Mile](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/miracle-mile): Museum Row on Wilshire and the subway underneath it. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90036.
- [West Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/west-hollywood): The Sunset Strip, Santa Monica Boulevard and the Design District in under two square miles. City of West Hollywood, ZIP 90069, 90046, 90048.
- [East Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/east-hollywood): Thai Town, Little Armenia and Barnsdall Park, right on the B Line. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90029.
- [Echo Park](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/echo-park): The lake, Dodger Stadium and hillside homes close to Downtown. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90026.
- [Los Feliz](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/los-feliz): Griffith Park as a backyard and Vermont Avenue for dinner. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90027.
- [Silver Lake](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/silver-lake): The reservoir loop, Sunset Junction and modernist houses on the hills. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 90026, 90039.
- [Encino](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/encino): Big lots south of Ventura, condos north of it, and the Sepulveda Basin. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91316, 91436.
- [North Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/north-hollywood): The NoHo Arts District and the end of the B Line. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91601, 91602, 91605, 91606.
- [Reseda](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/reseda): Big flat lots and some of the most attainable houses in the City of LA. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91335.
- [Sherman Oaks](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/sherman-oaks): Ventura Boulevard, the Galleria and the 405/101 interchange. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91403, 91423.
- [Studio City](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/studio-city): The Valley's most walkable stretch of Ventura Boulevard. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91604.
- [Tarzana](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/tarzana): Named for Tarzan, with hillside homes and room to spread out. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91356.
- [Valley Village](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/valley-village): Quiet streets between Studio City and NoHo. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91607.
- [Van Nuys](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/van-nuys): Entry-level houses, real lots and room for an ADU. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91401, 91405, 91406, 91411.
- [Woodland Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/woodland-hills): Warner Center, Topanga trails and the Valley's west end. City of Los Angeles, ZIP 91364, 91367.

## LA News: the headline for November 2026

- Nithya Raman is elected mayor of Los Angeles: City Councilmember Nithya Raman defeated incumbent Mayor Karen Bass in the Nov. 3 runoff. The Associated Press had Raman at 52.1% to Bass's 47.9% as of Nov. 5, when NBC News projected the win. Bass is the first incumbent LA mayor to lose a re-election bid since 2005. Raman takes office on Dec. 14, 2026.

# Nathaniel Grivas, West Los Angeles REALTOR®

Nathaniel Grivas is a REALTOR® (California DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, 9454 Wilshire Blvd, Ste 100, Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Compass is a licensed real estate broker, DRE #01991628.

- Call or text: 310-269-5541
- Email: nate.grivas@compass.com
- Website: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/
- Team: The Brodsky Group at Compass, over $100M in annual team sales (https://orbrodskygroup.com/)

## Areas served

From Westchester to Malibu, Hollywood to Silver Lake, and across the San Fernando Valley. ## Neighborhood guides

- [Malibu](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu): Twenty-one miles of coast, its own city, and septic tanks.
- [Marina del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey): Boats, high-rises and the bike path, run by the county.
- [Pacific Palisades](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/pacific-palisades): A beach town in the hills, rebuilding after the January 2025 fire.
- [Playa Vista](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-vista): A planned neighborhood with a park every few blocks.
- [Playa del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-del-rey): The quiet beach town most of LA forgets about.
- [Santa Monica](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica): The beach city with its own rules, its own schools and a train to Downtown.
- [Venice](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice): Abbot Kinney, the canals and the boardwalk, inside the City of LA.
- [Brentwood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/brentwood): Big lots, big trees, and the San Vicente coral trees.
- [Century City](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/century-city): High-rise living on the old 20th Century Fox backlot.
- [Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/cheviot-hills): Curving streets next to the best public park on the Westside.
- [Culver City](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/culver-city): Its own city, its own schools, and a downtown that works.
- [Mar Vista](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/mar-vista): Westside residential streets and mid-century homes, minutes from the beach.
- [Palms](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/palms): Dense, central and close to everything. The Westside's renter neighborhood.
- [Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/pico-robertson): Walkable, next to Beverly Hills, anchored by Pico Boulevard.
- [West LA & Sawtelle](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/west-la): Sawtelle Japantown and the Westside's best casual food.
- [Westchester](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westchester): Post-war houses, real yards, and LMU on the bluff.
- [Westwood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westwood): UCLA, Westwood Village and the Wilshire Corridor towers.
- [Bel Air](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/bel-air): Gated entrances, estate lots and the biggest houses in LA.
- [Beverly Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/beverly-hills): Its own city, its own schools, its own police, and the Flats.
- [Beverly Hills Post Office](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/bhpo): A 90210 address in the City of LA. Canyons, views and privacy.
- [Hollywood Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hollywood-hills): City views five minutes from Sunset.
- [Beverly Grove](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/beverly-grove): Third Street, the Beverly Center and Spanish duplexes on every block.
- [Fairfax District](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/fairfax): The Original Farmers Market, The Grove and blocks of Spanish duplexes.
- [Hancock Park & Larchmont](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hancock-park): Old LA mansions, Larchmont Village and the Wilshire Country Club.
- [Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hollywood): Studios, nightlife and the B Line. Live a few blocks off the boulevard.
- [Miracle Mile](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/miracle-mile): Museum Row on Wilshire and the subway underneath it.
- [West Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/west-hollywood): The Sunset Strip, Santa Monica Boulevard and the Design District in under two square miles.
- [East Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/east-hollywood): Thai Town, Little Armenia and Barnsdall Park, right on the B Line.
- [Echo Park](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/echo-park): The lake, Dodger Stadium and hillside homes close to Downtown.
- [Los Feliz](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/los-feliz): Griffith Park as a backyard and Vermont Avenue for dinner.
- [Silver Lake](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/silver-lake): The reservoir loop, Sunset Junction and modernist houses on the hills.
- [Encino](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/encino): Big lots south of Ventura, condos north of it, and the Sepulveda Basin.
- [North Hollywood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/north-hollywood): The NoHo Arts District and the end of the B Line.
- [Reseda](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/reseda): Big flat lots and some of the most attainable houses in the City of LA.
- [Sherman Oaks](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/sherman-oaks): Ventura Boulevard, the Galleria and the 405/101 interchange.
- [Studio City](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/studio-city): The Valley's most walkable stretch of Ventura Boulevard.
- [Tarzana](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/tarzana): Named for Tarzan, with hillside homes and room to spread out.
- [Valley Village](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/valley-village): Quiet streets between Studio City and NoHo.
- [Van Nuys](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/van-nuys): Entry-level houses, real lots and room for an ADU.
- [Woodland Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/woodland-hills): Warner Center, Topanga trails and the Valley's west end.

## Tools

- [Find your place in LA](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/neighborhood-quiz): Buy, rent, invest or build. Get matched to the right areas.
- [Transfer tax & mansion tax calculator](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax): What a sale costs in transfer taxes in LA, Santa Monica, Culver City, Beverly Hills and more.
- [What will it cost per month?](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage): Payment, taxes, insurance and HOA, plus the price your budget really buys.
- [Rent vs. buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy): Run your real numbers and see the year buying pulls ahead, if it does.
- [Compare two neighborhoods](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare): Side by side: rules, schools, price level and what daily life is like.
- [LA isn't one city](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules): Transfer taxes, rent control and schools change at every city line. Here's the map.

## Articles

- [Prop TE: Palisades fire sellers can skip LA's mansion tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/prop-te-palisades-mansion-tax-exemption): LA voters approved Proposition TE. Who qualifies, what it saves on a $6M sale, and who still pays Measure ULA in the Palisades.
- [The 90210 homes that pay LA's mansion tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/90210-beverly-hills-post-office-city-of-la): Beverly Hills Post Office uses the 90210 ZIP but sits in the City of LA. On a $6M sale that's a $267,000 difference in transfer tax.
- [Measure ULA in 2026: what LA's mansion tax actually costs a seller](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/measure-ula-mansion-tax-2026): The 2026 ULA thresholds, the math at $5.4M and $10.9M, the price zone where sellers net less by selling higher, and which neighborhoods it applies to.

Why clients hire him

## Nine reasons, with the receipts

### Deals that close, however they have to

At 616 N Fuller Ave, Nathaniel structured a $3,275,000 sale with seller financing. The sellers carried the loan, the buyer closed without a bank, and he represented both sides.

### Marketing that finds the buyer who pays the most

He marketed 18748 Lanark St in Reseda to developers as a land play. Seven offers in nine days, into escrow on day nine, and closed at $1,155,000: $156,000 over asking.

### Negotiation that keeps going after the offer

At 14757 Hartland St he won his buyer the house in multiple offers, then priced every item in the inspections and took $31,000 off in escrow, on a contract that said no credits.

### He reads a property like a developer

Zoning, lot size, ADU and lot-split potential, buildable square feet. Hartland was bought as a remodel plus two rentable ADUs. Lanark sold on what could be built on it.

### Access most agents don't have

Compass Private Exclusives and coming-soon homes, The Brodsky Group's off-market list, and lenders who approve the self-employed, investors and buyers the big banks pass on.

### A $100M+ team behind every client

The Brodsky Group, led by Or Brodsky at Compass Beverly Hills, closes over $100M every year. Clients get that pricing data, marketing and negotiating depth on every deal.

### Every side of the deal

Buyers, sellers, landlords, tenants, investors and builders. He leased 1127 Glenville Dr representing both the owner and the tenant, and lists homes up to $4.8M with his team.

### A marketer first

Loyola Marymount, Marketing with a Business Law minor, cum laude, and a marketing background at Compass before he sold his first home. Listings get the launch a brand would get.

### He answers

Call, text or email and you hear back the same day. Trusts, tenants, six owners on one title, unpermitted additions: complicated is fine. Bring it to him.

## Background

Nathaniel was raised between New York and Seattle and moved to Los Angeles for Loyola Marymount University, where he graduated cum laude in Marketing with a minor in Business Law. He worked in marketing at Compass before becoming an agent on The Brodsky Group, and he brings both to every deal: a marketer's eye for how a home is presented and found, and a contract-minded approach to terms, timelines and risk.

## What he does

Pricing and listing preparation, marketing and launch, buyer representation in competitive offers, negotiation through escrow, leasing, and development work: teardown and lot value analysis, zoning and ADU feasibility, and off-market sourcing for builders and investors. When a deal needs a lender, a contractor, an architect, a 1031 intermediary or a tax professional, he brings in the right one.

## Where he works

West Los Angeles, Beverly Hills and the Hills, the beach cities from Malibu to Playa del Rey, Hollywood to Silver Lake, and the San Fernando Valley. Every neighborhood he covers has its own page in [Local LA](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods), with a map of the places locals go.

## Outside of real estate

Basketball, golf and tennis, and time with friends and family.

The home

Architectural sophistication meets warm, organic design in this brand-new modern compound in the heart of Los Feliz. A five-bedroom main residence pairs with a fully independent three-bedroom ADU, and each home is crowned by its own rooftop lounge with panoramic hillside and mountain views.

The great room opens to a view balcony and a chef's kitchen built around a fluted-wood island with Thermador appliances. Upstairs, the primary suite has its own balcony, a sitting area, a custom walk-in closet and a spa-style bath with a freestanding soaking tub. Downstairs, a game room with a wet bar, a theatre and a second primary suite open to a private, hedge-lined backyard.

The rooftop over the main house has a covered outdoor kitchen, a stone fire pit, built-in lounge seating and room to add a spa. The ADU has its own entrance, full kitchen, two balconies and a rooftop deck, so it works for guests, family, an office or rental income. Minutes from Los Feliz Village, Griffith Park, Sunset Junction and Silver Lake.

# 18748 Lanark St, Reseda | Sold $1,155,000 | Nathaniel Grivas

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/homes/18748-lanark

Sold · Land play · Reseda

# 18748 Lanark St

Reseda, Los Angeles, CA 91335 · Represented the sellers

Sold for $1,155,000

**21,758** Sq ft lot

**300 ft** Lot depth

**7** Offers

**9** Days to escrow

**+15.6%** Over asking

A half-acre lot in Reseda that I marketed to developers as a land play. Multiple offers came in the first week, and I sold it for $1,155,000, $156,000 over asking.

Get a result like this Call 310-269-5541

[View on Compass ↗](https://www.compass.com/homedetails/18748-Lanark-St-Los-Angeles-CA-91335/2169982850442083505_lid/)

How it went

## The play: market the land to builders

18748 Lanark is a 21,758 sq ft lot, 72 feet wide and 300 feet deep, zoned RA-1. A 1928 house sits near the street, and about 150 feet of open land runs behind it. The family had owned it since 1994.

The value was in the land, so I marketed it as a land play for builders and developers. I flew drone aerials to show the full depth of the lot, pulled the zoning, and put it in front of investors and the agents who work with them.

It hit the MLS on August 11, 2026 at $999,000. Multiple offers came in the first week, seven by day nine, six of them all cash. On August 20 it went into escrow at $1,200,000.

The buyer's appraisal came back at $1,108,300. I held the price at $1,155,000, $46,700 above the appraisal, and got my sellers a 29-day stay after closing for $1 in rent. It closed on September 25, 2026.

Timeline

- **Aug 11** Listed at $999,000
- **First week** Multiple offers in
- **Aug 20** In escrow at $1,200,000 with 7 offers
- **Aug 27** Appraisal at $1,108,300
- **Sep 8** Price held at $1,155,000
- **Sep 25** Closed at $1,155,000

# 14757 Hartland St, Van Nuys | Sold $825,000 | Nathaniel Grivas

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/homes/14757-hartland

Bought · Development play · Van Nuys

# 14757 Hartland St

Van Nuys, Los Angeles, CA 91405 · Represented the buyer

Sold for $825,000

**7,119** Sq ft corner lot

**1,591** Sq ft house

**5** Days to contract

**$31K** Cut in escrow

**2** ADUs planned

A corner-lot development play in Van Nuys for my buyer: remodel the house, add two ADUs in the back and rent them out. I won it in multiple offers, then cut $31,000 off the price in escrow.

Find a deal like this Call 310-269-5541

[View on Compass ↗](https://www.compass.com/homedetails/14757-Hartland-St-Van-Nuys-CA-91405/2115491441809620633_lid/)

How it went

## The play: remodel, add two ADUs, rent

My buyer wanted a Valley corner lot with room to build. 14757 Hartland hit the MLS on May 28, 2026 at $825,000: a 1954 three-bedroom, two-bath house with 1,591 sq ft on a 7,119 sq ft corner lot at the start of a cul-de-sac.

The plan is to remodel the front house, add two ADUs in the back and rent them out. The corner lot and the position of the garage leave room behind the house for both units.

The seller had multiple offers. We came in all cash and went into contract on June 2, five days after it listed, at $856,000.

The seller's terms said no repairs and no credits. Our inspections found sewer, foundation, termite and chimney work, so I priced every item from the reports and took it back to the seller. A week into escrow the price came down to $825,000, $31,000 less. It closed on July 13, 2026.

Timeline

- **May 28** Listed at $825,000
- **Jun 2** In contract at $856,000 after multiple offers
- **Jun 9** Price cut to $825,000 in escrow
- **Jul 13** Closed at $825,000

# Malibu, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu

# Malibu

Twenty-one miles of coast, its own city, and septic tanks.

Malibu ZIP 90265 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Malibu listings What's my Malibu home worth?

What it’s like

Life runs along PCH: Point Dume and Zuma in the west, the Malibu Country Mart and Cross Creek in the middle, Carbon Beach and the pier to the east, Pepperdine up on the hill. It's quiet, spread out, and you drive everywhere.

Malibu is its own city stretching along about 21 miles of coastline west of Pacific Palisades. Parts of eastern Malibu burned in the January 2025 Palisades Fire.

[Beach](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#beach) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury) [Hills & views](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#views) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard)

## Where to eat, drink and go in Malibu

See them on the map →

Malibu is 21 miles of coastline along PCH, from Surfrider Beach and the pier to Zuma, Point Dume and the sea caves at El Matador. The restaurants lean on the views and the seafood, and the Santa Monica Mountains rise right behind the beach.

### Things to do

### Getty Villa

Free

17985 Pacific Coast Hwy

The Getty's re-created Roman villa, with Greek and Roman antiquities and gardens above the ocean. Free with a timed reservation.

**Do:** Reserve online and pay for parking; pair it with lunch on PCH. It stays open while the Getty Center closes for renovation in 2027, with some Center paintings on view here.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Getty+Villa+17985+Pacific+Coast+Hwy+Malibu+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Malibu+CA) [Getty](https://www.getty.edu/about/building-gettys-future/)

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Beachfront, bluff-top and canyon homes, many on large lots. Most of Malibu runs on septic systems instead of sewer, coastal permits add time to projects, and fire insurance is a real line item. Inspect all three before you write an offer.

**Good fit if**

You want privacy, ocean and space, and the drive into town doesn't bother you.

**Think twice if**

You want walkability or a short commute anywhere.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=malibu) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=malibu&b=pacific-palisades)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Malibu
- **Transfer tax:** 0.11% county only
- **Measure ULA:** No No
- **Rent control:** No local rent control. California's statewide cap (AB 1482) covers eligible rentals
- **Public schools:** Santa Monica-Malibu Unified, with a separate Malibu Unified in the works

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=malibu) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Weather

### Record king tides and big surf hit the coast on Thanksgiving morning

An extreme high tide of about 8 feet arrived Thursday morning, with a coastal flood advisory for the Malibu coast and LA County beaches through noon and a high surf warning until 9 p.m. Forecasters expect waves of roughly 6 to 11 feet with strong rip currents, and the LA Harbor tied its all-time high-water mark. If you're heading to the beach this weekend, check tide times before parking in beach lots and stay off the rocks and jetties.

[November 26, 2026](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/journal/2026-11-26) · Neighborhoods: [Malibu](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu), [Santa Monica](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica), [Venice](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice), [Marina del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey), [Playa del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-del-rey) · Sources: [ABC7 live updates](https://abc7.com/live-updates/king-tides-live-updates-socal-coastal-communities-brace-possible-record-breaking-high-surf-flooding-heres-timeline/20070299/), [Yahoo News / ABC7](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/articles/amtrak-pacific-surfliner-train-suspended-191750201.html)

# Marina del Rey, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey

# Marina del Rey

Boats, high-rises and the bike path, run by the county.

LA County ZIP 90292 $$$ · Upper

Get Marina del Rey listings What's my Marina del Rey home worth?

What it’s like

Life here runs around the water: paddleboarding in the harbor, calm water at Mother's Beach, the bike path to Venice and Playa del Rey, and sunset walks along the main channel.

Marina del Rey is unincorporated LA County, built around a small-craft harbor that opened in the 1960s. The county owns most of the land, so most buildings sit on long-term ground leases.

[Beach](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#beach) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** Unincorporated LA County

- **ZIP:** 90292

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Coast

- **Good fit if:** You want water views, the bike path and an easy condo lifestyle.

**Nathaniel Grivas** REALTOR® · The Brodsky Group at Compass [5.0 on Google](https://share.google/EwuPsirAOfl9Hvj1o)

Call Text

From above

## Marina del Rey by satellite

[Open in Google Maps ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Marina+del+Rey%2C+CA)

### Spots to know

- 1 **Mother's Beach** Calm harbor beach with no surf, good for paddling and swimming.
- 2 **The main channel** Walk or bike out to the jetty at the harbor mouth.
- 3 **Fisherman's Village** Harbor-front shops and boat tours.
- 4 **Ground leases** Most land is county-owned. Check the lease term on any condo.

**Thinking about Marina del Rey?** New Marina del Rey listings, off-market homes and lenders for any situation. Or a free value on your Marina del Rey home.

Local LA

## Where to eat, drink and go in Marina del Rey

See them on the map →

Marina del Rey wraps around North America's largest man-made small-craft harbor, with waterfront restaurants, a calm swimming beach and a bike path that runs to Venice and Playa del Rey. The best food is often a block off the water, along Washington Boulevard and in the strip malls inland.

20 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

Eat

### Coffee & breakfast

### The Cow's End Cafe

$$

34 Washington Blvd

A two-story beach cafe by the Venice Pier that regulars hit every morning, with fresh juices and sandwiches.

**Order:** A strawberry matcha or a fresh juice and a bagel. Opens at 6am.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=The+Cow%27s+End+Cafe+34+Washington+Blvd+Marina+del+Rey+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Marina+del+Rey+CA)

### Fratelli Marina

$

552 Washington Blvd

## Marina del Rey in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Mostly apartments and condo towers. Many condos are leasehold, so the length of the ground lease affects financing and value. Ask about the lease term before you fall in love with the view.

**Good fit if**

You want water views, the bike path and an easy condo lifestyle.

**Think twice if**

You want to own your land outright or have a yard.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=la-county) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=marina-del-rey&b=venice)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** Unincorporated LA County
- **Transfer tax:** 0.11% county only
- **Measure ULA:** No No
- **Rent control:** LA County's rent stabilization ordinance covers most apartments built before February 1, 1995
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=la-county) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Weather

### Record king tides and big surf hit the coast on Thanksgiving morning

An extreme high tide of about 8 feet arrived Thursday morning, with a coastal flood advisory for the Malibu coast and LA County beaches through noon and a high surf warning until 9 p.m. Forecasters expect waves of roughly 6 to 11 feet with strong rip currents, and the LA Harbor tied its all-time high-water mark. If you're heading to the beach this weekend, check tide times before parking in beach lots and stay off the rocks and jetties.

[November 26, 2026](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/journal/2026-11-26) · Neighborhoods: [Malibu](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu), [Santa Monica](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica), [Venice](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice), [Marina del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey), [Playa del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-del-rey) · Sources: [ABC7 live updates](https://abc7.com/live-updates/king-tides-live-updates-socal-coastal-communities-brace-possible-record-breaking-high-surf-flooding-heres-timeline/20070299/), [Yahoo News / ABC7](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/articles/amtrak-pacific-surfliner-train-suspended-191750201.html)

What is Marina del Rey like?

Life here runs around the water: paddleboarding in the harbor, calm water at Mother's Beach, the bike path to Venice and Playa del Rey, and sunset walks along the main channel.

Is Marina del Rey its own city?

Marina del Rey is in Unincorporated LA County. City and county rules apply.

Marina del Rey is mostly ZIP 90292.

Does rent control apply in Marina del Rey?

LA County's rent stabilization ordinance covers most apartments built before February 1, 1995

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

# Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/pacific-palisades

# Pacific Palisades

A beach town in the hills, rebuilding after the January 2025 fire.

City of LA ZIP 90272 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Pacific Palisades listings What's my Pacific Palisades home worth?

What it’s like

Before the fire it was the Westside's small town: a village center, canyon trails and beaches below the bluffs. Neighborhoods include the Alphabet Streets, the Huntington, the Riviera, the Highlands and Castellammare. Temescal Canyon and Topanga State Park trails start here.

Pacific Palisades is part of the City of LA, between Santa Monica and Malibu. The January 2025 Palisades Fire destroyed thousands of homes here, and much of the community is now in rebuild.

[Beach](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#beach) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Hills & views](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#views) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90272

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Coast

- **Good fit if:** You want space, the coast and a long-term hold, and you're comfortable buying into a rebuild.

### Spots to know

- 1 **The Village** The commercial center around Sunset and Swarthmore.
- 2 **Temescal Canyon** Trailhead with a loop up to the ridge.
- 3 **Will Rogers State Beach** Long beach below the bluffs along PCH.
- 4 **Proposition TE** The 2026 ULA exemption for fire-damaged homes. Rules on the transfer tax page.
- 5 **Rebuild permits** Check a lot's permit status before you price it.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Pacific Palisades

See them on the map →

Pacific Palisades is rebuilding after the January 2025 Palisades Fire. Palisades Village reopened in August 2026 after a $100 million restoration, and a growing list of local restaurants, shops and trails are open again. This guide lists only places confirmed open, and it grows as more return.

13 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

## Pacific Palisades in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Single-family homes and estates, with many lots now in rebuild. Buyers are looking at lots, rebuild plans and permits. In November 2026, LA voters approved Proposition TE, which exempts many fire-damaged homes sold by their January 2025 owners within five years from the ULA tax.

**Good fit if**

You want space, the coast and a long-term hold, and you're comfortable buying into a rebuild.

**Think twice if**

You need a finished neighborhood and everyday services right now.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=pacific-palisades&b=brentwood)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Pacific Palisades: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Pacific Palisades?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Pacific Palisades and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Pacific Palisades like?

Before the fire it was the Westside's small town: a village center, canyon trails and beaches below the bluffs. Neighborhoods include the Alphabet Streets, the Huntington, the Riviera, the Highlands and Castellammare. Temescal Canyon and Topanga State Park trails start here.

Is Pacific Palisades its own city?

Pacific Palisades is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Pacific Palisades?

Pacific Palisades is mostly ZIP 90272.

What kind of homes are in Pacific Palisades?

Single-family homes and estates, with many lots now in rebuild. Buyers are looking at lots, rebuild plans and permits. In November 2026, LA voters approved Proposition TE, which exempts many fire-damaged homes sold by their January 2025 owners within five years from the ULA tax.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Pacific Palisades?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Pacific Palisades?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Pacific Palisades?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Pacific Palisades a good fit for?

You want space, the coast and a long-term hold, and you're comfortable buying into a rebuild.

# Playa Vista, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-vista

# Playa Vista

A planned neighborhood with a park every few blocks.

City of LA ZIP 90094 $$$ · Upper

Get Playa Vista listings What's my Playa Vista home worth?

What it’s like

Everything is new and close: Runway for shopping and dinner, Central Park with a pool and courts, dozens of pocket parks, and the Ballona Wetlands next door. Very stroller friendly.

Playa Vista was built from scratch starting in the early 2000s on the former Hughes Aircraft site, where Howard Hughes built the Spruce Goose. The hangar is now office space, and tech campuses fill the area.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90094

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Coast

- **Good fit if:** You want new construction, parks and a short walk to work.

### Ballona Wetlands Ecological Reserve

Free

Ballona Wetlands

A protected coastal wetland with birding and a walking and bike path that links Marina del Rey and Playa del Rey.

**Do:** An early walk or bike ride along the path. Parts may be closed for restoration.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Newer condos, townhomes and some single-family homes. HOA dues are standard here, and many homes carry special assessments on the tax bill, so read the bill before you compare prices with older neighborhoods.

**Good fit if**

You want new construction, parks and a short walk to work.

**Think twice if**

You want character, older architecture or no HOA.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=playa-vista&b=playa-del-rey)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Everything is new and close: Runway for shopping and dinner, Central Park with a pool and courts, dozens of pocket parks, and the Ballona Wetlands next door. Very stroller friendly.

Is Playa Vista its own city?

Playa Vista is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Playa Vista?

Playa Vista is mostly ZIP 90094.

What kind of homes are in Playa Vista?

Newer condos, townhomes and some single-family homes. HOA dues are standard here, and many homes carry special assessments on the tax bill, so read the bill before you compare prices with older neighborhoods.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Playa Vista?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Playa Vista?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Playa Vista?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Playa Vista a good fit for?

You want new construction, parks and a short walk to work.

# Playa del Rey, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

# Playa del Rey

The quiet beach town most of LA forgets about.

City of LA ZIP 90293 $$$ · Upper

Get Playa del Rey listings What's my Playa del Rey home worth?

What it’s like

It feels like a beach town from a few decades ago: a short strip of bars and restaurants on Culver Boulevard, Del Rey Lagoon park, and Dockweiler's fire rings at night. The south end sits under the LAX flight path.

Playa del Rey is a small beach community in the City of LA, between Marina del Rey and LAX, with the Ballona Wetlands on one side and Dockweiler State Beach on the other.

[Beach](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#beach) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90293

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Coast

- **Good fit if:** You want the beach without the crowds and don't mind plane noise near the south end.

### Ballona Wetlands Ecological Reserve

Free

Next door in [Playa Vista](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-vista) · 1.6 mi · Ballona Wetlands

A protected coastal wetland with birding and a walking and bike path that links Marina del Rey and Playa del Rey.

**Do:** An early walk or bike ride along the path. Parts may be closed for restoration.

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Condos and townhomes near the beach, single-family homes up on the bluffs with ocean views.

**Good fit if**

You want the beach without the crowds and don't mind plane noise near the south end.

**Think twice if**

You want a big dining scene at your door.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=playa-del-rey&b=playa-vista)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Weather

### Record king tides and big surf hit the coast on Thanksgiving morning

An extreme high tide of about 8 feet arrived Thursday morning, with a coastal flood advisory for the Malibu coast and LA County beaches through noon and a high surf warning until 9 p.m. Forecasters expect waves of roughly 6 to 11 feet with strong rip currents, and the LA Harbor tied its all-time high-water mark. If you're heading to the beach this weekend, check tide times before parking in beach lots and stay off the rocks and jetties.

[November 26, 2026](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/journal/2026-11-26) · Neighborhoods: [Malibu](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu), [Santa Monica](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica), [Venice](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice), [Marina del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey), [Playa del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-del-rey) · Sources: [ABC7 live updates](https://abc7.com/live-updates/king-tides-live-updates-socal-coastal-communities-brace-possible-record-breaking-high-surf-flooding-heres-timeline/20070299/), [Yahoo News / ABC7](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/articles/amtrak-pacific-surfliner-train-suspended-191750201.html)

# Santa Monica, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica

# Santa Monica

The beach city with its own rules, its own schools and a train to Downtown.

Santa Monica ZIP 90401, 90402, 90403, 90404, 90405 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Santa Monica listings What's my Santa Monica home worth?

What it’s like

North of Montana Avenue is the quiet, polished side: wide streets, big trees and Montana's boutiques and coffee. Downtown has the Third Street Promenade, the Pier and the Metro E Line terminal at 4th and Colorado. Main Street and Ocean Park to the south feel looser and closer to Venice.

Santa Monica is its own city, about eight square miles of bluffs and flats between Pacific Palisades, Brentwood and Venice. It runs its own transfer tax, rent control and school district, so the rules change the second you cross the city line.

[Beach](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#beach) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Santa Monica

- **ZIP:** 90401, 90402, 90403, 90404, 90405

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Coast

- **Good fit if:** You want the beach, walkability and a train line, and you're fine paying for all three.

### Spots to know

- 1 **Montana Avenue** Shops and cafes on a residential street. The north side of town in one walk.
- 2 **Palisades Park** The bluff-top park along Ocean Avenue with the sunset view.
- 3 **Main Street** Ocean Park's stretch of restaurants and shops, a few blocks from the sand.
- 4 **Metro E Line** Downtown Santa Monica station connects to Culver City and Downtown LA.
- 5 **The beach bike path** The Marvin Braude trail runs south through Venice and beyond.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Santa Monica

See them on the map →

Santa Monica is a beach city with its own rules and a deep bench of restaurants, from a 1950s seaside shack to tasting menus that book a month out. Main Street and Ocean Park are the relaxed half; downtown, Wilshire and Montana carry the rest.

A seasonal menu built from the farmers market, and a Westside standard for years. Book ahead.

## Santa Monica in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

North of Montana is single-family and some of the most expensive streets on the Westside. Between Montana and Wilshire and through Mid-City you get condos, duplexes and older apartment buildings. Sunset Park and Ocean Park have smaller houses and bungalows. Much of the older apartment stock falls under Santa Monica rent control.

**Good fit if**

You want the beach, walkability and a train line, and you're fine paying for all three.

**Think twice if**

You want the most space for the money, or you don't want summer beach traffic near your street.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=santa-monica) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=santa-monica&b=venice)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Santa Monica
- **Transfer tax:** City tax on the full price: 0.3% under $5M, 0.6% from $5M, 5.6% at $8M and up, plus 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** No No. Santa Monica has its own top tier instead (5.6% at $8M+)
- **Rent control:** Santa Monica rent control covers most apartments built before April 10, 1979
- **Public schools:** Santa Monica-Malibu Unified (SMMUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=santa-monica) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Weather

### Record king tides and big surf hit the coast on Thanksgiving morning

An extreme high tide of about 8 feet arrived Thursday morning, with a coastal flood advisory for the Malibu coast and LA County beaches through noon and a high surf warning until 9 p.m. Forecasters expect waves of roughly 6 to 11 feet with strong rip currents, and the LA Harbor tied its all-time high-water mark. If you're heading to the beach this weekend, check tide times before parking in beach lots and stay off the rocks and jetties.

[November 26, 2026](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/journal/2026-11-26) · Neighborhoods: [Malibu](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu), [Santa Monica](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica), [Venice](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice), [Marina del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey), [Playa del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-del-rey) · Sources: [ABC7 live updates](https://abc7.com/live-updates/king-tides-live-updates-socal-coastal-communities-brace-possible-record-breaking-high-surf-flooding-heres-timeline/20070299/), [Yahoo News / ABC7](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/articles/amtrak-pacific-surfliner-train-suspended-191750201.html)

## Santa Monica: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Santa Monica?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Santa Monica and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Santa Monica like?

North of Montana Avenue is the quiet, polished side: wide streets, big trees and Montana's boutiques and coffee. Downtown has the Third Street Promenade, the Pier and the Metro E Line terminal at 4th and Colorado. Main Street and Ocean Park to the south feel looser and closer to Venice.

Is Santa Monica its own city?

Santa Monica is in City of Santa Monica. It sets its own taxes, rules and services.

What ZIP codes cover Santa Monica?

Santa Monica is mostly ZIP 90401, 90402, 90403, 90404, 90405.

What kind of homes are in Santa Monica?

North of Montana is single-family and some of the most expensive streets on the Westside. Between Montana and Wilshire and through Mid-City you get condos, duplexes and older apartment buildings. Sunset Park and Ocean Park have smaller houses and bungalows. Much of the older apartment stock falls under Santa Monica rent control.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Santa Monica?

City tax on the full price: 0.3% under $5M, 0.6% from $5M, 5.6% at $8M and up, plus 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Santa Monica?

Santa Monica rent control covers most apartments built before April 10, 1979

Which public schools serve Santa Monica?

Santa Monica-Malibu Unified (SMMUSD)

Who is Santa Monica a good fit for?

You want the beach, walkability and a train line, and you're fine paying for all three.

# Venice, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice

# Venice

Abbot Kinney, the canals and the boardwalk, inside the City of LA.

City of LA ZIP 90291 $$$ · Upper

Get Venice listings What's my Venice home worth?

What it’s like

Abbot Kinney Boulevard is the dinner-and-shopping strip. Ocean Front Walk, the skate park and the outdoor courts are the loud, famous part. A few blocks inland the streets go quiet, and the canals are some of the most peaceful blocks in the city.

Venice is part of the City of Los Angeles, between Santa Monica and Marina del Rey. Abbot Kinney built it in 1905 as Venice of America, and LA annexed it in 1926.

[Beach](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#beach) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative) [Nightlife](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#nightlife)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90291

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Coast

- **Good fit if:** You want to walk to the beach and to dinner, and you like energy around you.

### Spots to know

- 1 **Abbot Kinney Blvd** Restaurants, shops and the busiest sidewalk on the Westside.
- 2 **Venice Canals** Historic canal district with footbridges and no through traffic.
- 3 **Venice Beach courts** Outdoor basketball and paddle tennis by the boardwalk.
- 4 **Walk streets** Car-free residential lanes between Venice and Mar Vista.
- 5 **Rose Avenue** The north end of Venice, closer to Santa Monica.

Local LA

## Where to eat, drink and go in Venice

See them on the map →

Venice packs a beach town, one of LA's best restaurant streets and a handful of genuinely odd landmarks into a couple of square miles. Abbot Kinney and Rose Avenue carry most of the eating and drinking; the boardwalk, canals and skatepark carry the rest.

40 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

Eat

### Coffee & breakfast

### Menotti's Coffee Stop

$

56 Windward Ave

A tiny espresso bar a few steps off the boardwalk. People describe it as a friendly escape from the crowds, and the weekend line regularly spills onto the sidewalk.

**Order:** Any espresso drink to go before a walk on the boardwalk.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Menotti%27s+Coffee+Stop+56+Windward+Ave+Venice+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/restaurants/the-best-coffee-shops-in-venice) [Hotel Erwin](https://www.hotelerwin.com/venice-beach-coffee-shops/)

Coffee

### Groundwork Coffee

$

671 Rose Ave

Organic, house-roasted coffee from one of LA's best-known local roasters. Discover LA and longtime regulars point to the Rose Avenue shop as the Venice location worth the trip.

**Order:** Drip coffee or a cortado.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Groundwork+Coffee+671+Rose+Ave+Venice+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/restaurants/the-best-coffee-shops-in-venice) [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-venice-california) [Foursquare](https://foursquare.com/top-places/venice-los-angeles/best-places-trendy)

Coffee

### Intelligentsia Venice

$$

1331 Abbot Kinney Blvd

An airy, lab-like coffee bar that holds one of the highest Foursquare scores in Venice. Regulars rate the coffee and warn that it's busy and very much a scene.

**Order:** Pour-over, or an iced coffee for the walk down Abbot Kinney.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Intelligentsia+Venice+1331+Abbot+Kinney+Blvd+Venice+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Foursquare](https://foursquare.com/top-places/venice-los-angeles/best-places-trendy) [Hotel Erwin](https://www.hotelerwin.com/venice-beach-coffee-shops/)

### Things to do

### Venice Canals

Free

Off Dell Ave

Four blocks of canal houses and arched footbridges, and the calm counterpoint to the boardwalk.

**Do:** Walk the loop. You can launch your own non-motorized boat from the Venice Blvd ramp.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Venice+Canals+Off+Dell+Ave+Venice+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-venice) [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-venice-california)

Landmarks & sights Parks

### Venice Skatepark

Free

1800 Ocean Front Walk

The famous concrete bowls by the sand, often mid-video shoot. Watch from the fence.

**Do:** Go near sunset for the best light.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Venice+Skatepark+1800+Ocean+Front+Walk+Venice+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-venice) [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-venice-california)

Landmarks & sights Fitness & outdoor sports

### Mosaic Tile House

$$

1116 Palms Blvd

Two artists' home covered floor to roof in tile, paint and ceramics. Nothing else in LA looks like it.

**Do:** Open Saturdays noon to 3pm by email reservation, about $20.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Mosaic+Tile+House+1116+Palms+Blvd+Venice+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-venice)

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Small lots, walk streets where homes face a pedestrian path, 1920s cottages next to architect-built modern homes. Venice sits in the Coastal Zone, so many projects need a Coastal Development Permit on top of regular permits.

**Good fit if**

You want to walk to the beach and to dinner, and you like energy around you.

**Think twice if**

You want quiet weekends or a big yard.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=venice&b=santa-monica)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

### Read before you buy here

###

[Laws & MoneyMeasure ULA in 2026: what LA's mansion tax actually costs a sellerThe 2026 ULA thresholds, the math at $5.4M and $10.9M, the price zone where sellers net less by selling higher, and which neighborhoods it applies to. November 25, 2026](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/measure-ula-mansion-tax-2026)

Weather

### Record king tides and big surf hit the coast on Thanksgiving morning

An extreme high tide of about 8 feet arrived Thursday morning, with a coastal flood advisory for the Malibu coast and LA County beaches through noon and a high surf warning until 9 p.m. Forecasters expect waves of roughly 6 to 11 feet with strong rip currents, and the LA Harbor tied its all-time high-water mark. If you're heading to the beach this weekend, check tide times before parking in beach lots and stay off the rocks and jetties.

[November 26, 2026](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/journal/2026-11-26) · Neighborhoods: [Malibu](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/malibu), [Santa Monica](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/santa-monica), [Venice](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/venice), [Marina del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/marina-del-rey), [Playa del Rey](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/playa-del-rey) · Sources: [ABC7 live updates](https://abc7.com/live-updates/king-tides-live-updates-socal-coastal-communities-brace-possible-record-breaking-high-surf-flooding-heres-timeline/20070299/), [Yahoo News / ABC7](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/articles/amtrak-pacific-surfliner-train-suspended-191750201.html)

## Venice: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Venice?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Venice and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Venice like?

Abbot Kinney Boulevard is the dinner-and-shopping strip. Ocean Front Walk, the skate park and the outdoor courts are the loud, famous part. A few blocks inland the streets go quiet, and the canals are some of the most peaceful blocks in the city.

Is Venice its own city?

Venice is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Venice?

Venice is mostly ZIP 90291.

What kind of homes are in Venice?

Small lots, walk streets where homes face a pedestrian path, 1920s cottages next to architect-built modern homes. Venice sits in the Coastal Zone, so many projects need a Coastal Development Permit on top of regular permits.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Venice?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Venice?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Venice?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Venice a good fit for?

You want to walk to the beach and to dinner, and you like energy around you.

Free, no obligation

# Brentwood, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/brentwood

# Brentwood

Big lots, big trees, and the San Vicente coral trees.

City of LA ZIP 90049 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Brentwood listings What's my Brentwood home worth?

What it’s like

The Brentwood Country Mart and San Vicente's coral tree median set the tone. Brentwood Village on Barrington is the small-town center. North of Sunset, it's estate country.

Brentwood is a City of LA neighborhood west of the 405, running from the Wilshire flats up into Mandeville Canyon. The Getty Center sits on the ridge above it.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90049

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want space, trees and a quiet street close to the beach.

### Spots to know

- 1 **Brentwood Country Mart** The red barn at 26th and San Vicente.
- 2 **San Vicente Blvd** The coral tree median and the morning running route.
- 3 **Brentwood Village** Shops and restaurants on Barrington Court.
- 4 **The Getty Center** Museum and gardens on the hill above the 405.
- 5 **Mandeville Canyon** Long canyon road of private homes and horse properties.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Brentwood

See them on the map →

Brentwood's center is San Vicente Boulevard, a coral-tree-lined median with a run of cafes and Italian restaurants, plus Barrington Court just off it. The Getty sits on the hill above, the Country Mart anchors the west end, and the trails up Mandeville Canyon start a few minutes away.

Do

### Things to do

### The Getty

Free

1200 Getty Center Dr

The hilltop museum with world-class art, gardens and views from downtown to the ocean. Admission is free; parking is paid.

**Do:** Reserve a time online, ride the tram up and finish in the Central Garden. Go before March 15, 2027, when it closes for about a year of renovation.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=The+Getty+1200+Getty+Center+Dr+Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA) [Getty](https://www.getty.edu/about/building-gettys-future/)

Museums Art & galleries Landmarks & sights

### Hammer Museum

Free

Next door in [Westwood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westwood) · 2.0 mi · 10899 Wilshire Blvd

UCLA's free contemporary art museum with a courtyard, a strong shop and free screenings and talks.

**Do:** Check the events calendar, then lunch at Lulu.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hammer+Museum+10899+Wilshire+Blvd+Westwood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Westwood+Los+Angeles+CA)

Museums Art & galleries

### Westridge Trailhead and Mandeville Canyon

Free

2660 Westridge Rd

A dog-friendly ridge hike with an easy fire road and a steeper parallel trail, and views from downtown to the ocean.

**Do:** Go early or at sunset. There's no shade and little parking.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Westridge+Trailhead+and+Mandeville+Canyon+2660+Westridge+Rd+Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA)

Hikes & nature Dog-friendly Fitness & outdoor sports

### San Vicente Mountain Park

Free

17500 Mulholland Dr

A ridgetop park at an old Cold War Nike missile site with a lookout tower and huge views.

**Do:** Hike in from the Westridge trail, about four miles each way.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=San+Vicente+Mountain+Park+17500+Mulholland+Dr+Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA)

Hikes & nature Parks Landmarks & sights

### Brentwood Country Mart

$$

225 26th St

A red barn-style courtyard of boutiques, a bookstore, a toy store and cafes.

**Do:** Coffee, then a wander through the shops. The first hour of parking is free.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Brentwood+Country+Mart+225+26th+St+Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Brentwood+Los+Angeles+CA)

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Large homes and estates in Brentwood Park and north of Sunset, canyon homes in Mandeville and Kenter, and condos near San Vicente and Barrington south of Sunset.

**Good fit if**

You want space, trees and a quiet street close to the beach.

**Think twice if**

You want a bargain.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=brentwood&b=pacific-palisades)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

# Century City, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/century-city

# Century City

High-rise living on the old 20th Century Fox backlot.

City of LA ZIP 90067 $$$ · Upper

Get Century City listings What's my Century City home worth?

What it’s like

Westfield Century City for shopping and dinner, wide sidewalks, and a straight shot to Beverly Hills and Westwood. A Metro D Line station is under construction on Constellation Boulevard.

Century City was built starting in the 1960s on land that was once the 20th Century Fox backlot. The studio is still next door, and the district is a City of LA neighborhood of office and condo towers.

[Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90067

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want a doorman building in the middle of the Westside.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Century City

See them on the map →

Century City is the Westside's office and shopping district, built on former 20th Century Fox backlot land between Beverly Hills and West LA. Most of the eating and entertainment centers on Westfield Century City and the towers along Avenue of the Stars.

15 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

Eat

### Coffee & breakfast

### Clementine

$$

1751 Ensley Ave

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Full-service condo towers and some townhome complexes. Good fit for buyers who want security, amenities and no yard work.

**Good fit if**

You want a doorman building in the middle of the Westside.

**Think twice if**

You want character or a garden.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=century-city&b=beverly-hills)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Century City: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Century City?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Century City and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Century City like?

Westfield Century City for shopping and dinner, wide sidewalks, and a straight shot to Beverly Hills and Westwood. A Metro D Line station is under construction on Constellation Boulevard.

Is Century City its own city?

Century City is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Century City?

Century City is mostly ZIP 90067.

What kind of homes are in Century City?

Full-service condo towers and some townhome complexes. Good fit for buyers who want security, amenities and no yard work.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Century City?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Century City?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Century City?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Century City a good fit for?

You want a doorman building in the middle of the Westside.

# Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/cheviot-hills

# Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park

Curving streets next to the best public park on the Westside.

City of LA ZIP 90064 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park listings What's my Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park home worth?

What it’s like

Cheviot Hills Recreation Center has tennis courts, a pool and even an archery range. Rancho Park Golf Course is one of the busiest public courses in the city. Pico Boulevard has the local restaurants, and the E Line stops at Westwood/Rancho Park.

Cheviot Hills and Rancho Park are City of LA neighborhoods between Century City, Palms and Culver City, wrapped around the Rancho Park golf course and Hillcrest Country Club.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90064

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want a quiet residential street with a big public park in walking distance.

### Spots to know

- 1 **Cheviot Hills Recreation Center** Tennis, pool, fields and archery.
- 2 **Rancho Park Golf Course** Municipal course that once hosted the LA Open.
- 3 **Motor Avenue** The main street through the neighborhood.
- 4 **Westwood/Rancho Park station** Metro E Line on the north edge.

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1930s and 1940s traditional homes on larger lots in Cheviot Hills, smaller homes in Rancho Park, and steady teardown and new-build activity.

**Good fit if**

You want a quiet residential street with a big public park in walking distance.

**Think twice if**

You want nightlife.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=cheviot-hills&b=century-city)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Who is a real estate agent who works in Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park like?

Cheviot Hills Recreation Center has tennis courts, a pool and even an archery range. Rancho Park Golf Course is one of the busiest public courses in the city. Pico Boulevard has the local restaurants, and the E Line stops at Westwood/Rancho Park.

Is Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park its own city?

Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park?

Cheviot Hills & Rancho Park is mostly ZIP 90064.

# Culver City, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/culver-city

# Culver City

Its own city, its own schools, and a downtown that works.

Culver City ZIP 90230, 90232 $$$ · Upper

Get Culver City listings What's my Culver City home worth?

What it’s like

Downtown Culver City has the restaurants, theaters and the Metro E Line station. The Ballona Creek bike path runs to the beach. The Baldwin Hills Scenic Overlook stairs are the local workout with the best view of the basin.

Culver City is an independent city of about five square miles surrounded by Los Angeles. It's home to Sony Pictures Studios and Amazon Studios, and it runs its own schools, rent control and transfer tax.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Culver City

- **ZIP:** 90230, 90232

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want a small-city feel, walkable dinners and a train.

- 4 **Culver City Unified** The city's own school district.
- 5 **Fox Hills** Condo and townhome area on the south side of the city.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Culver City

See them on the map →

Culver City is the Westside's studio town, with a walkable downtown around the Culver Hotel and Culver Steps, the Helms and Platform districts for food and shopping, and the Baldwin Hills overlook for the best view on this side of town. It's one of the easiest places in LA to spend a whole day on foot.
