### Mitsuwa Marketplace

$

Next door in [Mar Vista](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/mar-vista) · 2.3 mi · 3760 S Centinela Ave

A Japanese supermarket with a busy food court and a bookstore full of manga and stationery.

**Do:** Ramen or tempura in the food court, then snacks and mochi from the market.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1920s to 1950s houses in neighborhoods like Carlson Park and Culver Crest, hillside homes in Blair Hills, and condos in Fox Hills. Sales over $1.5M pay Culver City's bracketed transfer tax.

**Good fit if**

You want a small-city feel, walkable dinners and a train.

**Think twice if**

You're selling above $1.5M and want to avoid an extra transfer tax.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=culver-city) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=culver-city&b=palms)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Culver City
- **Transfer tax:** Measure RE brackets from 0.45% up to 4% on the top slice, plus 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** No No. Culver City has its own bracketed tax (Measure RE)
- **Rent control:** Culver City rent control covers most apartments built before February 1, 1995
- **Public schools:** Culver City Unified (CCUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=culver-city) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Culver City: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Culver City?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Culver City and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Culver City like?

Downtown Culver City has the restaurants, theaters and the Metro E Line station. The Ballona Creek bike path runs to the beach. The Baldwin Hills Scenic Overlook stairs are the local workout with the best view of the basin.

Is Culver City its own city?

Culver City is in City of Culver City. It sets its own taxes, rules and services.

What ZIP codes cover Culver City?

Culver City is mostly ZIP 90230, 90232.

What kind of homes are in Culver City?

1920s to 1950s houses in neighborhoods like Carlson Park and Culver Crest, hillside homes in Blair Hills, and condos in Fox Hills. Sales over $1.5M pay Culver City's bracketed transfer tax.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Culver City?

Measure RE brackets from 0.45% up to 4% on the top slice, plus 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Culver City?

Culver City rent control covers most apartments built before February 1, 1995

Which public schools serve Culver City?

Culver City Unified (CCUSD)

Who is Culver City a good fit for?

You want a small-city feel, walkable dinners and a train.

# Mar Vista, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/mar-vista

# Mar Vista

Westside residential streets and mid-century homes, minutes from the beach.

City of LA ZIP 90066 $$$ · Upper

Get Mar Vista listings What's my Mar Vista home worth?

What it’s like

Sunday means the Mar Vista Farmers Market on Grand View Boulevard. Venice Boulevard has the local restaurants and coffee. Mar Vista Hill gives you ocean views, and the rec center fills up on weekends.

Mar Vista is a City of LA neighborhood between Venice, Culver City and Palms. It grew up after World War II, and it's one of the most active new-construction areas on the Westside.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90066

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want a house with a yard on the Westside and quick freeway access.

- 2 **Mar Vista Tract** Gregory Ain's modernist homes, protected as an HPOZ.
- 3 **Mar Vista Recreation Center** Fields, courts and a pool in the middle of the neighborhood.
- 4 **Mar Vista Hill** The streets with the ocean views.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Mar Vista

See them on the map →

Mar Vista is Venice's quieter neighbor, with a walkable stretch of Venice Boulevard around Grand View, a Sunday farmers market and one of the best Japanese markets on the Westside. Its restaurant scene has grown fast, from Taiwanese comfort food on Grand View to a French bistro on Centinela.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Post-war single-family homes on lots around 5,000 to 7,000 square feet, with plenty of remodels, new builds and ADUs. The Mar Vista Tract, designed by Gregory Ain in 1948, is a protected historic district.

**Good fit if**

You want a house with a yard on the Westside and quick freeway access.

**Think twice if**

You want to walk to most of what you need.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=mar-vista&b=venice)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

## Mar Vista: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Mar Vista?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Mar Vista and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Mar Vista like?

Sunday means the Mar Vista Farmers Market on Grand View Boulevard. Venice Boulevard has the local restaurants and coffee. Mar Vista Hill gives you ocean views, and the rec center fills up on weekends.

Is Mar Vista its own city?

Mar Vista is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Mar Vista?

Mar Vista is mostly ZIP 90066.

What kind of homes are in Mar Vista?

Post-war single-family homes on lots around 5,000 to 7,000 square feet, with plenty of remodels, new builds and ADUs. The Mar Vista Tract, designed by Gregory Ain in 1948, is a protected historic district.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Mar Vista?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Mar Vista?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Mar Vista?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Mar Vista a good fit for?

You want a house with a yard on the Westside and quick freeway access.

# Palms, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/palms

# Palms

Dense, central and close to everything. The Westside's renter neighborhood.

City of LA ZIP 90034 $$ · Moderate

Get Palms listings What's my Palms home worth?

What it’s like

Two Metro E Line stations, a short drive to Culver City's restaurants, and a lot of apartment buildings. It's practical, central and busy.

Palms is one of the oldest neighborhoods on LA's Westside, founded in 1886 and annexed to the City of LA in 1915. It sits between Culver City, Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills and West LA.

[Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit) [More for the money](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#value) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90034

- **Price level:** $$ · Moderate

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You rent or want a first condo in a central Westside spot with a train.

## Palms in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Mostly apartments and condos, with a large share under LA's rent stabilization rules. Pockets of single-family homes sit south of the 10.

**Good fit if**

You rent or want a first condo in a central Westside spot with a train.

**Think twice if**

You want quiet streets and a yard.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=palms&b=culver-city)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

# Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/pico-robertson

# Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood

Walkable, next to Beverly Hills, anchored by Pico Boulevard.

City of LA ZIP 90035 $$$ · Upper

Get Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood listings What's my Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood home worth?

What it’s like

Pico Boulevard is lined with kosher bakeries, restaurants and small shops, and the neighborhood is easy to walk. Beverlywood to the south is quieter and almost all single-family.

Pico-Robertson and Beverlywood sit just south and east of Beverly Hills in the City of LA, centered on Pico and Robertson Boulevards.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90035

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want to walk to everything and be minutes from Beverly Hills.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Duplexes and small apartment buildings north of Pico, many under LA rent stabilization. 1930s and 1940s Spanish and traditional homes on the residential streets. Beverlywood is single-family.

**Good fit if**

You want to walk to everything and be minutes from Beverly Hills.

**Think twice if**

You want big lots.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=pico-robertson&b=beverly-hills)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

What is Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood like?

Pico Boulevard is lined with kosher bakeries, restaurants and small shops, and the neighborhood is easy to walk. Beverlywood to the south is quieter and almost all single-family.

Is Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood its own city?

Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood?

Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood is mostly ZIP 90035.

What kind of homes are in Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood?

Duplexes and small apartment buildings north of Pico, many under LA rent stabilization. 1930s and 1940s Spanish and traditional homes on the residential streets. Beverlywood is single-family.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Pico-Robertson & Beverlywood?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

# West LA & Sawtelle, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/west-la

# West LA & Sawtelle

Sawtelle Japantown and the Westside's best casual food.

City of LA ZIP 90025 $$$ · Upper

Get West LA & Sawtelle listings What's my West LA & Sawtelle home worth?

What it’s like

Ramen, boba, sushi and dessert lines on Sawtelle, the Nuart Theatre on Santa Monica Boulevard, and E Line stations on the south edge. Central to everything on the Westside.

West Los Angeles is the City of LA area between Santa Monica, Brentwood, Westwood and Palms. Sawtelle Boulevard is its food street, officially designated Sawtelle Japantown.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90025

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want a condo in the middle of the Westside with food you can walk to.

## Where to eat, drink and go in West LA & Sawtelle

See them on the map →

West LA's heart is Sawtelle Japantown, a few walkable blocks of ramen counters, izakayas, dessert shops and pop-culture stores between Santa Monica and Olympic Boulevards. Around it, Pico and National have some of the Westside's best neighborhood bars.

### Hammer Museum

Free

Next door in [Westwood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westwood) · 1.7 mi · 10899 Wilshire Blvd

UCLA's free contemporary art museum with a courtyard, a strong shop and free screenings and talks.

**Do:** Check the events calendar, then lunch at Lulu.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Apartments and townhome-style condos, with smaller single-family homes south of Olympic. Good condo inventory for first-time buyers.

**Good fit if**

You want a condo in the middle of the Westside with food you can walk to.

**Think twice if**

You want a house with space.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=west-la&b=westwood)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

What is West LA & Sawtelle like?

Ramen, boba, sushi and dessert lines on Sawtelle, the Nuart Theatre on Santa Monica Boulevard, and E Line stations on the south edge. Central to everything on the Westside.

Is West LA & Sawtelle its own city?

West LA & Sawtelle is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

West LA & Sawtelle is mostly ZIP 90025.

# Westchester, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westchester

# Westchester

Post-war houses, real yards, and LMU on the bluff.

City of LA ZIP 90045 $$ · Moderate

Get Westchester listings What's my Westchester home worth?

What it’s like

Suburban and steady: Kentwood and Westport Heights for houses, the Sepulveda and Manchester corridors for errands, Westchester Park for sports. The closer you get to LAX, the more you hear the planes.

Westchester grew up in the 1940s around LAX and the aircraft plants. It's a City of LA neighborhood with Loyola Marymount University on the bluff above Playa Vista.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [More for the money](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#value)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90045

- **Price level:** $$ · Moderate

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want a house and a yard on the Westside for less, and you fly a lot.

Plane noise bothers you.

# Westwood, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/westwood

# Westwood

UCLA, Westwood Village and the Wilshire Corridor towers.

City of LA ZIP 90024 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Westwood listings What's my Westwood home worth?

What it’s like

Westwood Village has the old movie palaces, the Hammer Museum and campus energy. The Wilshire Corridor is condo living with doormen. North of Wilshire, the residential streets are quiet and tree-lined. The Metro D Line subway extension to Westwood is under construction.

Westwood is the City of LA neighborhood around UCLA, from the Wilshire Corridor high-rises to the single-family streets of Westwood Hills and Holmby Westwood.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90024

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Westside

- **Good fit if:** You want a condo with service, or a classic house close to UCLA.

Landmarks & sights

### The Getty

Free

Next door in [Brentwood](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/brentwood) · 2.0 mi · 1200 Getty Center Dr

The hilltop museum with world-class art, gardens and views from downtown to the ocean. Admission is free; parking is paid.

**Do:** Reserve a time online, ride the tram up and finish in the Central Garden. Go before March 15, 2027, when it closes for about a year of renovation.

## Westwood in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Full-service condos on Wilshire, student apartments near campus, and 1920s and 1930s homes in Westwood Hills, Holmby Westwood and Little Holmby.

**Good fit if**

You want a condo with service, or a classic house close to UCLA.

**Think twice if**

You want parking to be easy.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=westwood&b=bel-air)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Westwood: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Westwood?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Westwood and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Westwood like?

Westwood Village has the old movie palaces, the Hammer Museum and campus energy. The Wilshire Corridor is condo living with doormen. North of Wilshire, the residential streets are quiet and tree-lined. The Metro D Line subway extension to Westwood is under construction.

Is Westwood its own city?

Westwood is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Westwood?

Westwood is mostly ZIP 90024.

What kind of homes are in Westwood?

Full-service condos on Wilshire, student apartments near campus, and 1920s and 1930s homes in Westwood Hills, Holmby Westwood and Little Holmby.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Westwood?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Westwood?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Westwood?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Westwood a good fit for?

You want a condo with service, or a classic house close to UCLA.

# Bel Air, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/bel-air

# Bel Air

Gated entrances, estate lots and the biggest houses in LA.

City of LA ZIP 90077 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Bel Air listings What's my Bel Air home worth?

What it’s like

Private and green: the Hotel Bel-Air, Bel-Air Country Club, Stone Canyon Reservoir, and winding roads with almost no foot traffic.

Bel Air is a City of LA hillside neighborhood north of UCLA, founded by Alphonzo Bell in 1923. Its East Gate and West Gate sit on Sunset Boulevard.

[Hills & views](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#views) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90077

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Beverly Hills & the Hills

- **Good fit if:** You want maximum privacy and land close to the Westside.

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Estates, hillside view homes and new spec mansions. Hillside building rules cap size, and because most sales here clear $5.4M, Measure ULA hits a large share of them.

**Good fit if**

You want maximum privacy and land close to the Westside.

**Think twice if**

You want a neighborhood you can walk.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=bel-air&b=bhpo)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Bel Air: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Bel Air?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Bel Air and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Bel Air like?

Private and green: the Hotel Bel-Air, Bel-Air Country Club, Stone Canyon Reservoir, and winding roads with almost no foot traffic.

Is Bel Air its own city?

Bel Air is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Bel Air?

Bel Air is mostly ZIP 90077.

What kind of homes are in Bel Air?

Estates, hillside view homes and new spec mansions. Hillside building rules cap size, and because most sales here clear $5.4M, Measure ULA hits a large share of them.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Bel Air?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Bel Air?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Bel Air?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Bel Air a good fit for?

You want maximum privacy and land close to the Westside.

# Beverly Hills, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/beverly-hills

# Beverly Hills

Its own city, its own schools, its own police, and the Flats.

Beverly Hills ZIP 90210, 90211, 90212 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Beverly Hills listings What's my Beverly Hills home worth?

What it’s like

Rodeo Drive and the Golden Triangle for shopping, Beverly Gardens Park along Santa Monica Boulevard, and the Flats: gridded streets of big homes between Santa Monica Boulevard and Sunset. Trousdale Estates in the hills is mid-century modern territory.

Beverly Hills is an independent city of about 5.7 square miles surrounded by Los Angeles. It has its own police and fire departments and its own school district.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Beverly Hills

- **ZIP:** 90210, 90211, 90212

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Beverly Hills & the Hills

- **Good fit if:** You want city services, walkable shopping and a famous address.

- 3 **Greystone Mansion** Historic estate and public gardens.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Beverly Hills

See them on the map →

Beverly Hills does the classics well: power-lunch rooms, old Hollywood martinis, serious omakase and some of the best sandwiches in LA. Between meals there are mansions, gardens and galleries within a few blocks of Rodeo.

$$

414 N Beverly Dr

Breakfast Lunch

### Faregrounds

$$

459 N Roxbury Dr

A bright corner cafe that has become the Beverly Hills breakfast burrito spot. The kitchen cooks without seed oils, and the matcha menu is as big a draw as the coffee.

**Order:** The Faregrounds breakfast burrito with a strawberry matcha. Open weekdays from 7 a.m.; closed on weekends.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Faregrounds+459+N+Roxbury+Dr+Beverly+Hills+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Love Beverly Hills](https://lovebeverlyhills.com/restaurants/view/faregrounds) [Atly](https://www.atly.com/united-states/california/beverly-hills/best-breakfast)

### Fountain Coffee Room at the Beverly Hills Hotel

$$$

9641 Sunset Blvd

A pink, 1949 soda-fountain counter inside the Beverly Hills Hotel with about 20 stools and breakfast served all day. It is walk-in only, so you sit at the counter and watch the room.

**Order:** Silver dollar pancakes and a milkshake. Daily, 7 a.m. to 4 p.m.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Fountain+Coffee+Room+at+the+Beverly+Hills+Hotel+9641+Sunset+Blvd+Beverly+Hills+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Dorchester Collection](https://www.dorchestercollection.com/los-angeles/the-beverly-hills-hotel/dining/fountain-coffee-room) [Time Out](https://timeout.com/los-angeles/restaurants/fountain-coffee-room)

## Beverly Hills in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Large homes in the Flats, hillside view homes in Trousdale and above Sunset, and duplexes, apartments and condos south of Wilshire. The city does not charge its own transfer tax, so sellers pay only the county's 0.11%.

**Good fit if**

You want city services, walkable shopping and a famous address.

**Think twice if**

You assume every 90210 address is in Beverly Hills. Many aren't.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=beverly-hills) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=beverly-hills&b=bhpo)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Beverly Hills
- **Transfer tax:** 0.11% county only
- **Measure ULA:** No No
- **Rent control:** Beverly Hills rent stabilization covers most multi-family rentals
- **Public schools:** Beverly Hills Unified (BHUSD)

## Beverly Hills: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Beverly Hills?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Beverly Hills and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Beverly Hills like?

Rodeo Drive and the Golden Triangle for shopping, Beverly Gardens Park along Santa Monica Boulevard, and the Flats: gridded streets of big homes between Santa Monica Boulevard and Sunset. Trousdale Estates in the hills is mid-century modern territory.

Is Beverly Hills its own city?

Beverly Hills is in City of Beverly Hills. It sets its own taxes, rules and services.

What ZIP codes cover Beverly Hills?

Beverly Hills is mostly ZIP 90210, 90211, 90212.

What kind of homes are in Beverly Hills?

Large homes in the Flats, hillside view homes in Trousdale and above Sunset, and duplexes, apartments and condos south of Wilshire. The city does not charge its own transfer tax, so sellers pay only the county's 0.11%.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Beverly Hills?

0.11% county only

Does rent control apply in Beverly Hills?

Beverly Hills rent stabilization covers most multi-family rentals

Which public schools serve Beverly Hills?

Beverly Hills Unified (BHUSD)

Who is Beverly Hills a good fit for?

You want city services, walkable shopping and a famous address.

What it’s like

Coldwater Canyon, Benedict Canyon and Franklin Canyon, with Mulholland on top. Franklin Canyon Park has a lake and trails, and TreePeople's park sits at Coldwater and Mulholland.

Beverly Hills Post Office, or BHPO, is the hillside area above Beverly Hills that uses the 90210 ZIP code but sits in the City of Los Angeles. That means LA's transfer tax, Measure ULA and LAUSD schools apply here.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Hillside homes and view lots. LA's Baseline Hillside Ordinance limits how big you can build, and most of the area is in a high fire hazard zone, which affects insurance.

**Good fit if**

You want privacy and views 10 minutes from Beverly Hills.

**Think twice if**

You want to walk anywhere, or you assumed 90210 means Beverly Hills schools.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=bhpo&b=beverly-hills)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

# Hollywood Hills, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

# Hollywood Hills

City views five minutes from Sunset.

City of LA ZIP 90068, 90046, 90069 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Hollywood Hills listings What's my Hollywood Hills home worth?

What it’s like

Runyon Canyon for the crowded hike, Lake Hollywood for the quiet loop, the Hollywood Bowl for summer nights, and Mulholland for the drive. You're up in the hills and still close to the Sunset Strip.

The Hollywood Hills run along the Santa Monica Mountains above Hollywood and West Hollywood, from the Bird Streets to Laurel Canyon and Lake Hollywood. Almost all of it is in the City of LA.

### Bronson Caves

Free

3200 Canyon Dr

A short, easy walk to the cave used as the Batcave in the 1960s TV show, with a clear view of the Hollywood Sign.

**Do:** Go early for parking, then keep going on the Brush Canyon trail.

## Hollywood Hills in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Hillside homes on steep lots, from mid-century post-and-beam to new glass boxes. Expect hillside building limits, fire zone insurance, stairs and tight parking.

**Good fit if**

You want views and nightlife close by.

**Think twice if**

You hate stairs, hairpin turns or street parking.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=hollywood-hills&b=west-hollywood)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Hollywood Hills: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Hollywood Hills?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Hollywood Hills and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Hollywood Hills like?

Runyon Canyon for the crowded hike, Lake Hollywood for the quiet loop, the Hollywood Bowl for summer nights, and Mulholland for the drive. You're up in the hills and still close to the Sunset Strip.

Is Hollywood Hills its own city?

Hollywood Hills is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Hollywood Hills?

Hollywood Hills is mostly ZIP 90068, 90046, 90069.

What kind of homes are in Hollywood Hills?

Hillside homes on steep lots, from mid-century post-and-beam to new glass boxes. Expect hillside building limits, fire zone insurance, stairs and tight parking.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Hollywood Hills?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Hollywood Hills?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Hollywood Hills?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Hollywood Hills a good fit for?

You want views and nightlife close by.

# Beverly Grove, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/beverly-grove

# Beverly Grove

Third Street, the Beverly Center and Spanish duplexes on every block.

City of LA ZIP 90048 $$$ · Upper

Get Beverly Grove listings What's my Beverly Grove home worth?

What it’s like

West Third Street for shops and restaurants, Melrose Place for boutiques, La Cienega's restaurant row, and Cedars-Sinai as a major employer. It's central and very walkable.

Beverly Grove is the City of LA neighborhood between West Hollywood, Beverly Hills and the Fairfax District, home to Cedars-Sinai and the Beverly Center.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90048

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Central

- **Good fit if:** You want a central, walkable spot, or a duplex to live in and rent out.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Beverly Grove

See them on the map →

Beverly Grove is one of LA's most restaurant-dense neighborhoods, centered on West 3rd Street and Beverly Boulevard between La Cienega and Fairfax. It's an easy place to walk from coffee to lunch to a long dinner, with the Beverly Center at its west end.

18 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

### Nightlife

### Blue Collar

$$

Next door in [Fairfax District](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/fairfax) · 0.9 mi · 361 S Fairfax Ave

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1920s and 1930s Spanish duplexes are the signature, along with single-family homes north of Beverly Boulevard and condos. Duplexes here work for owner-occupants who want rent from the second unit.

**Good fit if**

You want a central, walkable spot, or a duplex to live in and rent out.

**Think twice if**

You want a big backyard.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=beverly-grove&b=fairfax)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Beverly Grove: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Beverly Grove?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Beverly Grove and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Beverly Grove like?

West Third Street for shops and restaurants, Melrose Place for boutiques, La Cienega's restaurant row, and Cedars-Sinai as a major employer. It's central and very walkable.

Is Beverly Grove its own city?

Beverly Grove is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Beverly Grove?

Beverly Grove is mostly ZIP 90048.

What kind of homes are in Beverly Grove?

1920s and 1930s Spanish duplexes are the signature, along with single-family homes north of Beverly Boulevard and condos. Duplexes here work for owner-occupants who want rent from the second unit.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Beverly Grove?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Beverly Grove?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Beverly Grove?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Beverly Grove a good fit for?

You want a central, walkable spot, or a duplex to live in and rent out.

# Fairfax District, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

# Fairfax District

The Original Farmers Market, The Grove and blocks of Spanish duplexes.

City of LA ZIP 90036 $$$ · Upper

Get Fairfax District listings What's my Fairfax District home worth?

What it’s like

The Original Farmers Market has been at Third and Fairfax since 1934. The Grove is next door, Pan Pacific Park has fields and a rec center, Canter's Deli is open late, and Fairfax Avenue is a streetwear destination.

The Fairfax District is a City of LA neighborhood around Fairfax Avenue between Melrose and Wilshire, next to The Grove and CBS Television City.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90036

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Central

- **Good fit if:** You want to walk to the market and live in a classic LA building.

- 2 **The Grove** Outdoor mall with the trolley and the fountain.
- 3 **Pan Pacific Park** Fields, rec center and the playground.
- 4 **Fairfax Avenue** Streetwear shops, Canter's and the Melrose crossing.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Fairfax District

See them on the map →

The Fairfax District runs from the Original Farmers Market and The Grove up Fairfax Avenue, LA's classic deli and streetwear strip, to Melrose. It's walkable, busy at all hours and home to some of the city's most famous food stalls.

23 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1920s and 1930s Spanish duplexes and fourplexes, many under rent stabilization, plus single-family homes on the side streets. Duplex-to-single-family conversions are common.

**Good fit if**

You want to walk to the market and live in a classic LA building.

**Think twice if**

You want new construction.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=fairfax&b=beverly-grove)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county

- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is a real estate agent who works in Fairfax District?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Fairfax District and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Fairfax District like?

The Original Farmers Market has been at Third and Fairfax since 1934. The Grove is next door, Pan Pacific Park has fields and a rec center, Canter's Deli is open late, and Fairfax Avenue is a streetwear destination.

Is Fairfax District its own city?

Fairfax District is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Fairfax District?

Fairfax District is mostly ZIP 90036.

What kind of homes are in Fairfax District?

1920s and 1930s Spanish duplexes and fourplexes, many under rent stabilization, plus single-family homes on the side streets. Duplex-to-single-family conversions are common.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Fairfax District?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Fairfax District?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Fairfax District?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

You want to walk to the market and live in a classic LA building.

# Hancock Park & Larchmont, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hancock-park

# Hancock Park & Larchmont

Old LA mansions, Larchmont Village and the Wilshire Country Club.

City of LA ZIP 90004, 90020 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Hancock Park & Larchmont listings What's my Hancock Park & Larchmont home worth?

What it’s like

Wide lawns, big trees and no sidewalk clutter. Larchmont Boulevard has the coffee, the farmers market and the small shops. The Wilshire Country Club sits in the middle.

Hancock Park is one of LA's oldest wealthy neighborhoods, developed in the 1920s on land owned by the Hancock family. Larchmont Village is its walkable main street.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard)

## At a glance

- **ZIP:** 90004, 90020

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Central

- **Good fit if:** You want an old-LA house on a quiet, walkable street.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1920s Tudor, Spanish and Colonial estates. Hancock Park is an HPOZ, so exterior changes go through historic review.

**Good fit if**

You want an old-LA house on a quiet, walkable street.

**Think twice if**

You want a modern build with no review process.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=hancock-park&b=miracle-mile)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

# Hollywood

Studios, nightlife and the B Line. Live a few blocks off the boulevard.

City of LA ZIP 90028, 90038 $$ · Moderate

Get Hollywood listings What's my Hollywood home worth?

What it’s like

Busy and loud around Hollywood and Highland, calmer on the side streets. The Hollywood Bowl, Hollywood Forever's summer movies, and studios like Paramount keep it a working entertainment neighborhood.

Hollywood is the City of LA neighborhood around Hollywood Boulevard and Sunset, with Paramount Pictures on Melrose and Metro B Line stations under the boulevard.

[Nightlife](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#nightlife) [Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative) [More for the money](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#value)

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Apartments and condos, 1920s bungalow courts, and historic pockets like Spaulding Square. Lots of rental stock under rent stabilization.

**Good fit if**

You want energy, a train and to be close to the studios.

**Think twice if**

You want quiet streets.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=hollywood&b=hollywood-hills)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

### A packed holiday weekend: the Hollywood Christmas Parade, the Auto Show and holiday concerts

The Hollywood Christmas Parade returns Sunday, Nov. 29, and the LA Auto Show runs downtown through the same day. Walt Disney Concert Hall kicks off its holiday series this weekend with Home Alone and Elf screened with a live orchestra, and the Smorgasburg holiday market is on the calendar too.

## Hollywood: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Hollywood?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Hollywood and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Hollywood like?

Busy and loud around Hollywood and Highland, calmer on the side streets. The Hollywood Bowl, Hollywood Forever's summer movies, and studios like Paramount keep it a working entertainment neighborhood.

Is Hollywood its own city?

Hollywood is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Hollywood?

Hollywood is mostly ZIP 90028, 90038.

What kind of homes are in Hollywood?

Apartments and condos, 1920s bungalow courts, and historic pockets like Spaulding Square. Lots of rental stock under rent stabilization.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Hollywood?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Hollywood?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Hollywood?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Hollywood a good fit for?

You want energy, a train and to be close to the studios.

# Miracle Mile, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/miracle-mile

# Miracle Mile

Museum Row on Wilshire and the subway underneath it.

City of LA ZIP 90036 $$$ · Upper

Get Miracle Mile listings What's my Miracle Mile home worth?

What it’s like

Museums at your door, Park La Brea's towers, and Metro D Line subway stations on Wilshire. The residential streets south of Wilshire are calm and walkable.

Miracle Mile is the City of LA neighborhood along Wilshire Boulevard between Fairfax and La Brea, home to LACMA, the Academy Museum, the Petersen and the La Brea Tar Pits.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90036

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Central

- **Good fit if:** You want culture and a subway stop in walking distance.

### Spots to know

- 1 **LACMA** The county art museum and the Urban Light lampposts.
- 2 **La Brea Tar Pits** Ice-age fossils in a public park.
- 3 **Academy Museum** The film museum at Wilshire and Fairfax.
- 4 **Miracle Mile HPOZ** Historic rules on exterior changes. Check before you remodel.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Miracle Mile

See them on the map →

Miracle Mile is the stretch of Wilshire Boulevard between La Brea and Fairfax known as Museum Row, home to LACMA, the Academy Museum, the Petersen and the La Brea Tar Pits, with Art Deco buildings along Wilshire and a strong run of restaurants on La Brea.

### Coffee & breakfast

### Savor

### Parks & outdoors

### La Brea Tar Pits

Free

5801 Wilshire Blvd

Ice Age asphalt seeps and active excavation sites in the park. The museum building is closed for renovation until about 2028, but much of the park stays open.

**Do:** Walk to the Lake Pit and look for the tar bubbling up.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=La+Brea+Tar+Pits+5801+Wilshire+Blvd+Miracle+Mile+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [La Brea Tar Pits](https://tarpits.org/last-chance) [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Miracle+Mile+Los+Angeles+CA)

## Miracle Mile in pictures

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1920s and 1930s duplexes and single-family homes, much of it inside the Miracle Mile HPOZ, plus condos on Wilshire and the Park La Brea apartments.

**Good fit if**

You want culture and a subway stop in walking distance.

**Think twice if**

You want to change a historic facade.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=miracle-mile&b=fairfax)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Who is a real estate agent who works in Miracle Mile?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Miracle Mile and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Miracle Mile like?

Museums at your door, Park La Brea's towers, and Metro D Line subway stations on Wilshire. The residential streets south of Wilshire are calm and walkable.

Is Miracle Mile its own city?

Miracle Mile is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Miracle Mile?

Miracle Mile is mostly ZIP 90036.

What kind of homes are in Miracle Mile?

1920s and 1930s duplexes and single-family homes, much of it inside the Miracle Mile HPOZ, plus condos on Wilshire and the Park La Brea apartments.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Miracle Mile?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Miracle Mile?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Miracle Mile?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

# West Hollywood, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/west-hollywood

# West Hollywood

The Sunset Strip, Santa Monica Boulevard and the Design District in under two square miles.

West Hollywood ZIP 90069, 90046, 90048 $$$ · Upper

Get West Hollywood listings What's my West Hollywood home worth?

What it’s like

The Sunset Strip's music venues, the Rainbow District's nightlife on Santa Monica Boulevard, the Design District around Melrose and Robertson, and very walkable residential streets in between.

West Hollywood is its own city of about 1.9 square miles between Beverly Hills and Hollywood. It has its own rent stabilization rules and no city transfer tax beyond the county's 0.11%.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Nightlife](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#nightlife) [Condo friendly](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#condo) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of West Hollywood

- **ZIP:** 90069, 90046, 90048

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Central

- **Good fit if:** You want to walk to dinner and stay out late.

### Spots to know

- 1 **The Sunset Strip** The Whisky, the Roxy and the billboards.
- 2 **Santa Monica Blvd** WeHo's nightlife and Pride route.
- 3 **Design District** Furniture showrooms and galleries around Melrose and Robertson.
- 4 **Pacific Design Center** The blue and green buildings on Melrose.
- 5 **Kings Road Park** Small park in the middle of the east side.

## Where to eat, drink and go in West Hollywood

See them on the map →

West Hollywood packs the Sunset Strip's music clubs and comedy rooms, Santa Monica Boulevard's bars and the Melrose and Robertson restaurant row into under two square miles. It's one of the most walkable cities in LA, and brunch here is a weekend sport.

62 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

Eat

### Coffee & breakfast

### Dayglow

$$

866 Huntley Dr

A specialty coffee bar with a rotating menu of house drinks and guest roasters.

**Order:** Whatever seasonal latte is on the board; vegan ice cream sits next door.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dayglow+866+Huntley+Dr+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/restaurants/the-best-coffee-shops-in-west-hollywood)

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=WeHo+Bistro+1040+N+La+Cienega+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [The Infatuation](https://www.theinfatuation.com/los-angeles/guides/where-to-brunch-in-west-hollywood)

### First Of All

$$

8200 Santa Monica Blvd

### Nightlife

### The Abbey

$$

692 N Robertson Blvd

West Hollywood's most famous bar, and one of the best known LGBTQ+ bars in the world. Several rooms, dancing at night and the neighborhood's best drag brunch.

**Order:** Weekend drag brunch. Expect lines on weekend nights.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=The+Abbey+692+N+Robertson+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-west-hollywood) [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/bars/gay-la-best-gay-bars-and-clubs-in-los-angeles) [The Infatuation](https://www.theinfatuation.com/los-angeles/guides/where-to-brunch-in-west-hollywood)

### Delilah

$$$$

7969 Santa Monica Blvd

A Roaring Twenties supper club from the h.wood group, with live music, a grand bar and one of the hardest reservations in LA. Dress up; this is the room people book for the big night.

**Order:** Book weeks out, arrive for dinner and stay for the late set.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Delilah+7969+Santa+Monica+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [CBS LA](https://www.cbsnews.com/losangeles/news/best-bars-in-west-hollywood) [Visit West Hollywood](https://www.visitwesthollywood.com/nightlife/)

Cocktail bars & lounges Live music Date night

### The Nice Guy

$$$

401 N La Cienega Blvd

A dark, red-booth Italian lounge that has been the city's most reliable celebrity scene since 2014. Getting in without a reservation is hard on weekends.

**Order:** Book a late table, order the chicken parm and a martini, and use the photo booth.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=The+Nice+Guy+401+N+La+Cienega+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Infatuation](https://www.theinfatuation.com/los-angeles/guides/the-sceniest-restaurants-in-west-hollywood-ranked)

Cocktail bars & lounges Late night

### Sunset at the West Hollywood EDITION

$$$$

9040 Sunset Blvd

A basement nightclub under the EDITION hotel with a strict door and a dressed-up crowd. The most polished late-night room on the Strip.

**Order:** Get on a list or book a table before you go. Dress code is enforced.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Sunset+at+the+West+Hollywood+EDITION+9040+Sunset+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Discotech](https://discotech.me/los-angeles/best-clubs-in-west-hollywood-los-angeles/)

Cocktail bars & lounges Late night

### White Rabbit Sky Lounge at the Valorian

$$$

8440 Sunset Blvd

The rooftop pool lounge that used to be Skybar, renamed in 2026 when the Mondrian became the Valorian. Day-to-night parties with a view over the whole city.

**Order:** Go for sunset on a Thursday or Friday and dress for it.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=White+Rabbit+Sky+Lounge+at+the+Valorian+8440+Sunset+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [The Rooftop Guide](https://www.therooftopguide.com/rooftop-bars-in-los-angeles/white-rabbit-sky-lounge.html) [Visit West Hollywood](https://www.visitwesthollywood.com/nightlife/)

Rooftops & views Cocktail bars & lounges

643 N La Cienega Blvd

### Schindler House

$

835 N Kings Rd

Rudolph Schindler's 1922 house, a modern architecture landmark that hosts art shows.

**Do:** Tours run Wednesday through Sunday; reserve ahead.

### Sunset Strip

Free

Sunset Blvd, Doheny Dr to Crescent Heights

The mile and a half of billboards, music clubs, comedy rooms and hotels that made West Hollywood famous.

**Do:** Walk it at night, from the Whisky to the Comedy Store.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Sunset+Strip+Sunset+Blvd%2C+Doheny+Dr+to+Crescent+Heights+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-west-hollywood)

Landmarks & sights

### Rainbow Crosswalks

Free

Santa Monica Blvd and N San Vicente Blvd

The permanent rainbow crosswalks at the center of WeHo Pride every June.

**Do:** Photos, then the bars along Santa Monica Boulevard.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rainbow+Crosswalks+Santa+Monica+Blvd+and+N+San+Vicente+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-west-hollywood)

### Parks & outdoors

### West Hollywood Park

Free

647 N San Vicente Blvd

The city's main park, with a modern playground, courts, a dog park and the library next door.

**Do:** Pickleball or tennis, then the library's rooftop views.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=West+Hollywood+Park+647+N+San+Vicente+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=West+Hollywood+CA) [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-west-hollywood)

Parks Kids & family Dog-friendly

### Plummer Park

Free

7377 Santa Monica Blvd

A busy neighborhood park with tennis and pickleball courts, a playground and free summer concerts.

**Do:** Summer Sunday concerts.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Plummer+Park+7377+Santa+Monica+Blvd+West+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=West+Hollywood+CA) [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/west-hollywood)

Parks Kids & family Fitness & outdoor sports

### Kings Road Park

Free

1000 Kings Rd

A small, shady pocket park with water features and a toddler playground.

**Do:** A quiet lunch break on a bench.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Condos, rent-stabilized apartments, small houses in the Norma Triangle and on the east side, and hillside homes above Sunset.

**Good fit if**

You want to walk to dinner and stay out late.

**Think twice if**

You want a yard or a quiet Saturday night.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=west-hollywood) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=west-hollywood&b=beverly-hills)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of West Hollywood
- **Transfer tax:** 0.11% county only
- **Measure ULA:** No No
- **Rent control:** West Hollywood rent stabilization covers most apartments built before July 1, 1979
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=west-hollywood) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## West Hollywood: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in West Hollywood?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in West Hollywood and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is West Hollywood like?

The Sunset Strip's music venues, the Rainbow District's nightlife on Santa Monica Boulevard, the Design District around Melrose and Robertson, and very walkable residential streets in between.

Is West Hollywood its own city?

West Hollywood is in City of West Hollywood. It sets its own taxes, rules and services.

What ZIP codes cover West Hollywood?

West Hollywood is mostly ZIP 90069, 90046, 90048.

What kind of homes are in West Hollywood?

Condos, rent-stabilized apartments, small houses in the Norma Triangle and on the east side, and hillside homes above Sunset.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in West Hollywood?

0.11% county only

Does rent control apply in West Hollywood?

West Hollywood rent stabilization covers most apartments built before July 1, 1979

Which public schools serve West Hollywood?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is West Hollywood a good fit for?

You want to walk to dinner and stay out late.

# East Hollywood, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/east-hollywood

# East Hollywood

Thai Town, Little Armenia and Barnsdall Park, right on the B Line.

City of LA ZIP 90029 $$ · Moderate

Get East Hollywood listings What's my East Hollywood home worth?

What it’s like

Barnsdall Art Park holds Frank Lloyd Wright's Hollyhock House, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Thai Town's restaurants line Hollywood Boulevard, and the hospital row on Sunset and Vermont is a major employer.

East Hollywood is a City of LA neighborhood between Hollywood, Los Feliz and Silver Lake. It includes Thai Town and Little Armenia, and Metro B Line stations at Vermont.

[Near Metro rail](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#transit) [More for the money](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#value) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90029

- **Price level:** $$ · Moderate

- **Region:** Eastside

- **Good fit if:** You want value next to the Eastside's best neighborhoods.

Local LA

## Where to eat, drink and go in East Hollywood

See them on the map →

East Hollywood takes in Thai Town, Little Armenia, Virgil Village and the Melrose Hill strip, between Hollywood and Los Feliz. It is one of the deepest eating neighborhoods in LA, with some of the city's best Thai cooking, a run of chef-driven spots on Melrose and a few great small bars.

22 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

$

Crackly, deeply browned bagels that draw a morning line and can sell out.

**Order:** The burnt everything bagel with salmon. Go before 10am.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Apartments, duplexes, bungalows and some of the most attainable houses this close to Los Feliz and Silver Lake. Much of the rental stock is under rent stabilization.

**Good fit if**

You want value next to the Eastside's best neighborhoods.

**Think twice if**

You want quiet, leafy streets.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=east-hollywood&b=los-feliz)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## East Hollywood: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in East Hollywood?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in East Hollywood and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is East Hollywood like?

Barnsdall Art Park holds Frank Lloyd Wright's Hollyhock House, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Thai Town's restaurants line Hollywood Boulevard, and the hospital row on Sunset and Vermont is a major employer.

Is East Hollywood its own city?

East Hollywood is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover East Hollywood?

East Hollywood is mostly ZIP 90029.

What kind of homes are in East Hollywood?

Apartments, duplexes, bungalows and some of the most attainable houses this close to Los Feliz and Silver Lake. Much of the rental stock is under rent stabilization.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in East Hollywood?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in East Hollywood?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve East Hollywood?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is East Hollywood a good fit for?

# Echo Park, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/echo-park

# Echo Park

The lake, Dodger Stadium and hillside homes close to Downtown.

City of LA ZIP 90026 $$ · Moderate

Get Echo Park listings What's my Echo Park home worth?

What it’s like

Echo Park Lake with the paddle boats and lotus beds, Dodger Stadium up the hill, Elysian Park's trails, and a strip of bars, music venues and restaurants on Sunset.

Echo Park is a City of LA neighborhood northwest of Downtown, between Silver Lake and Elysian Park.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative) [Nightlife](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#nightlife) [Hills & views](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#views) [More for the money](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#value)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90026

- **Price level:** $$ · Moderate

- **Region:** Eastside

- **Good fit if:** You want character close to Downtown.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Echo Park

See them on the map →

Echo Park wraps around its lake, with swan boats and a palm-lined loop, and Sunset Boulevard runs through it with some of the Eastside's best bars, taquerias and music rooms. Dodger Stadium sits right above it in Chavez Ravine.

$

1294 Sunset Blvd

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Hillside bungalows, Victorian homes in Angelino Heights, small-lot homes and apartments. Close-in value for the Eastside.

**Good fit if**

You want character close to Downtown.

**Think twice if**

Game-day traffic would drive you crazy.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=echo-park&b=silver-lake)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

# Los Feliz, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/los-feliz

# Los Feliz

Griffith Park as a backyard and Vermont Avenue for dinner.

City of LA ZIP 90027 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Los Feliz listings What's my Los Feliz home worth?

What it’s like

Los Feliz Village on Vermont and Hillhurst has the restaurants, bars and bookstores. The park has hiking, golf, the zoo and the observatory. Frank Lloyd Wright's Ennis House sits on the hill.

Los Feliz is a City of LA neighborhood at the foot of Griffith Park, one of the largest city parks in the country, with the Griffith Observatory and the Greek Theatre in the hills above.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Hills & views](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#views) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative) [Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Luxury](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#luxury)

- **Region:** Eastside

### Spots to know

- 1 **Griffith Park** Trails, golf, the zoo and the observatory.
- 2 **Los Feliz Village** Vermont and Hillhurst Avenues.
- 3 **The Greek Theatre** Outdoor concert venue in the park.
- 4 **Ennis House** Frank Lloyd Wright's textile-block house on Glendower.
- 5 **Los Feliz Estates** The hillside streets above Los Feliz Blvd.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Los Feliz

See them on the map →

Los Feliz sits at the foot of Griffith Park, with two walkable village streets, Hillhurst and Vermont, lined with cafes, old-school Italian spots, bookstores and a century-old movie palace. It's also the easiest way up to the Observatory and the Greek Theatre.

36 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

Eat

### Coffee & breakfast

### Maru Coffee

$$

1936 Hillhurst Ave

A minimalist espresso bar that many coffee people rank among the best in LA. The line moves faster than it looks.

**Order:** The cream top or a vanilla latte. It's small, so plan to take it to go.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Maru+Coffee+1936+Hillhurst+Ave+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA)

Coffee

### Handles Coffee

$

4459 Sunset Blvd

A two-story cafe at the bottom of Los Feliz with strong, espresso-heavy drinks and a friendly counter.

**Order:** The house flat white with sweet cream. Card only.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Handles+Coffee+4459+Sunset+Blvd+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/eat-drink/coffee-lovers-in-la) [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA)

Coffee

### Alcove Cafe and Bakery

$$

1929 Hillhurst Ave

A pair of historic bungalows with a big shaded patio, and Los Feliz's go-to brunch for decades. Breakfast runs until 5pm.

**Order:** Something from the pastry case and a breakfast plate on the patio. Valet helps with parking.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Alcove+Cafe+and+Bakery+1929+Hillhurst+Ave+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/restaurants/best-los-feliz-restaurants) [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA)
