Do

### Culture & shows

### Griffith Observatory

Free

2800 E Observatory Rd

LA's Art Deco hilltop observatory, with free astronomy exhibits, a planetarium and the city's best sunset view.

**Do:** Walk up the two-mile trail instead of driving, then stay for sunset and a planetarium show.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Griffith+Observatory+2800+E+Observatory+Rd+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Culture Trip](https://theculturetrip.com/north-america/usa/california/articles/the-top-10-things-to-do-and-see-in-los-feliz) [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/visit/hidden-gems-in-los-feliz) [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-los-feliz)

Landmarks & sights Museums Hikes & nature

### Greek Theatre

$$$

2700 N Vermont Ave

A 1929 open-air amphitheater in a canyon, and one of the best places in LA to see a summer show.

**Do:** Walk or rideshare. The stacked parking can take longer than the concert.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Greek+Theatre+2700+N+Vermont+Ave+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-griffith-park) [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/visit/hidden-gems-in-los-feliz) [Culture Trip](https://theculturetrip.com/north-america/usa/california/articles/the-top-10-things-to-do-and-see-in-los-feliz)

Live music

### Vista Theatre

$$

4473 Sunset Dr

A century-old single-screen movie palace with an Egyptian interior. Every other row was removed, so there's real legroom.

**Do:** A matinee with real butter on the popcorn.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Vista+Theatre+4473+Sunset+Dr+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/visit/hidden-gems-in-los-feliz) [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-los-feliz)

Movies Landmarks & sights

### Los Feliz 3

$

1822 N Vermont Ave

The neighborhood's other historic cinema, smaller and cheaper than the Vista.

**Do:** A movie, then Goldburger next door.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Los+Feliz+3+1822+N+Vermont+Ave+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-los-feliz) [The Infatuation](https://www.theinfatuation.com/los-angeles/guides/the-best-restaurants-in-los-feliz)

Movies

### Barnsdall Art Park and Hollyhock House

$

4800 Hollywood Blvd

A hilltop park around Frank Lloyd Wright's Hollyhock House, with summer wine tastings and outdoor movies.

**Do:** Tour the house, then catch the sunset from the lawn.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Barnsdall+Art+Park+and+Hollyhock+House+4800+Hollywood+Blvd+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-los-feliz)

Landmarks & sights Art & galleries Parks

### Autry Museum of the American West

$$

4700 Western Heritage Way

A big museum of the American West inside Griffith Park.

**Do:** Pair it with a Griffith Park picnic.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Autry+Museum+of+the+American+West+4700+Western+Heritage+Way+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Culture Trip](https://theculturetrip.com/north-america/usa/california/articles/the-top-10-things-to-do-and-see-in-los-feliz)

### Parks & outdoors

### Griffith Park

Free

Vermont Ave entrance

More than 4,000 acres of trails, canyons and picnic lawns right behind the neighborhood.

**Do:** A morning hike from the Vermont side, then brunch on Hillhurst.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Griffith+Park+Vermont+Ave+entrance+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-los-feliz) [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/things-to-do/things-to-do-in-griffith-park)

Parks Hikes & nature Kids & family

### Berendo Stairs

Free

N Berendo St

A historic public staircase that gives you a real workout on the way toward Griffith Park.

**Do:** Do a few laps early in the morning.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Berendo+Stairs+N+Berendo+St+Los+Feliz+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Discover Los Angeles](https://www.discoverlosangeles.com/visit/hidden-gems-in-los-feliz)

### Silver Lake Reservoir

Free

Next door in [Silver Lake](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/silver-lake) · 1.7 mi · Silver Lake Blvd

The neighborhood's centerpiece: a loop for running, a meadow for picnics and room for dogs.

**Do:** Walk the loop, then eat on the Silver Lake Blvd strip just south.

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1920s Spanish and Tudor homes on the flats, estates in Los Feliz Oaks, Laughlin Park and the Los Feliz Estates hills, and apartments near Vermont.

**Good fit if**

You want a walkable village and a huge park at your door.

**Think twice if**

You need to be on the Westside every day.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=los-feliz&b=silver-lake)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Los Feliz: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Los Feliz?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Los Feliz and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Los Feliz like?

Los Feliz Village on Vermont and Hillhurst has the restaurants, bars and bookstores. The park has hiking, golf, the zoo and the observatory. Frank Lloyd Wright's Ennis House sits on the hill.

Is Los Feliz its own city?

Los Feliz is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Los Feliz?

Los Feliz is mostly ZIP 90027.

What kind of homes are in Los Feliz?

1920s Spanish and Tudor homes on the flats, estates in Los Feliz Oaks, Laughlin Park and the Los Feliz Estates hills, and apartments near Vermont.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Los Feliz?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Los Feliz?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Los Feliz?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Los Feliz a good fit for?

You want a walkable village and a huge park at your door.

Free, no obligation

# Silver Lake, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/silver-lake

# Silver Lake

The reservoir loop, Sunset Junction and modernist houses on the hills.

City of LA ZIP 90026, 90039 $$$ · Upper

Get Silver Lake listings What's my Silver Lake home worth?

What it’s like

The reservoir walking path and the Meadow on weekends, Sunset Junction's coffee and shops, public stairways through the hills, and some of LA's best modern architecture by Neutra, Schindler and Lautner.

Silver Lake is a City of LA neighborhood built around the Silver Lake Reservoir, between Los Feliz and Echo Park.

[Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Creative](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#creative) [Hills & views](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#views) [Nightlife](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#nightlife)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 90026, 90039

- **Price level:** $$$ · Upper

- **Region:** Eastside

- **Good fit if:** You want design, walkability and an Eastside creative crowd.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Silver Lake

See them on the map →

Silver Lake is the Eastside's living room: a reservoir to walk around, a long run of restaurants on Sunset, and some of the best bars in the city. The best stretches are Sunset Junction and the strip of Silver Lake Boulevard just south of the reservoir.

Free

Silver Lake Blvd

The neighborhood's centerpiece: a loop for running, a meadow for picnics and room for dogs.

### Echo Park Lake

Free

Next door in [Echo Park](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/echo-park) · 0.8 mi · 751 Echo Park Ave

A palm-ringed lake with swan pedal boats, a fountain and a walking loop. The lotus bed blooms each summer.

**Do:** Rent a swan boat at sunset.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Echo+Park+Lake+751+Echo+Park+Ave+Echo+Park+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles/restaurants/the-best-restaurants-in-echo-park) [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Echo+Park+Los+Angeles+CA)

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Hillside homes, mid-century modern houses, 1920s bungalows and small-lot subdivisions with newer homes.

**Good fit if**

You want design, walkability and an Eastside creative crowd.

**Think twice if**

You want a flat lot and a big yard.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=silver-lake&b=los-feliz)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

The reservoir walking path and the Meadow on weekends, Sunset Junction's coffee and shops, public stairways through the hills, and some of LA's best modern architecture by Neutra, Schindler and Lautner.

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

South of Ventura in 91436: large homes and estates on big lots, some gated. North of Ventura in 91316: condos, townhomes and ranch homes.

**Good fit if**

You want land and privacy in the Valley, or an easy condo near Ventura.

**Think twice if**

You want nightlife.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=encino&b=sherman-oaks)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

### Wat Thai Food Court

$

8225 Coldwater Canyon Ave

Weekend-only Thai street food stalls on the grounds of a Buddhist temple. You trade cash for tokens to pay.

**Do:** Arrive before noon, when the popular stalls start to sell out.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Wat+Thai+Food+Court+8225+Coldwater+Canyon+Ave+North+Hollywood+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [The Infatuation](https://www.theinfatuation.com/los-angeles/guides/restaurants-north-hollywood) [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=North+Hollywood+CA)

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Apartments and new mid-rise buildings near the station, 1940s bungalows, and entry-level houses in the side neighborhoods.

**Good fit if**

You want a train, a scene and Valley prices.

**Think twice if**

You want leafy, quiet streets.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=north-hollywood&b=valley-village)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Who is a real estate agent who works in North Hollywood?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in North Hollywood and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is North Hollywood like?

The NoHo Arts District's small theaters and bars, Lankershim Boulevard, and a quick subway ride to Hollywood and Downtown. Universal City is one stop away.

Is North Hollywood its own city?

North Hollywood is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover North Hollywood?

North Hollywood is mostly ZIP 91601, 91602, 91605, 91606.

What kind of homes are in North Hollywood?

Apartments and new mid-rise buildings near the station, 1940s bungalows, and entry-level houses in the side neighborhoods.

0.45% city + 0.11% county

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

## Sherman Oaks: common questions

Who is a real estate agent who works in Sherman Oaks?

Nathaniel Grivas, REALTOR® (DRE #02410660) with The Brodsky Group at Compass Beverly Hills, helps people buy, sell, rent, invest and build in Sherman Oaks and across West LA, Beverly Hills and the San Fernando Valley. Call or text 310-269-5541.

What is Sherman Oaks like?

Ventura Boulevard's restaurants and shops, the Sherman Oaks Galleria, Westfield Fashion Square, and the Van Nuys-Sherman Oaks Park sports fields.

Is Sherman Oaks its own city?

Sherman Oaks is in City of Los Angeles. City and county rules apply.

What ZIP codes cover Sherman Oaks?

Sherman Oaks is mostly ZIP 91403, 91423.

What kind of homes are in Sherman Oaks?

South of Ventura: hillside and larger homes with views. North of Ventura: ranch homes on flat lots, condos and apartments.

What is the transfer tax when you sell in Sherman Oaks?

0.45% city + 0.11% county

Does rent control apply in Sherman Oaks?

LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978

Which public schools serve Sherman Oaks?

Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

Who is Sherman Oaks a good fit for?

You work on the Westside and want a Valley house.

# Studio City, Los Angeles: Best Restaurants, Bars, Things to Do & Map | Local LA

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/studio-city

# Studio City

The Valley's most walkable stretch of Ventura Boulevard.

City of LA ZIP 91604 $$$$ · Top of market

Get Studio City listings What's my Studio City home worth?

What it’s like

Ventura Boulevard's restaurants, Tujunga Village's small shops, Fryman Canyon for the hike, and quick access over the hill to Hollywood.

Studio City is a City of LA neighborhood in the southeast Valley, named for the studio lot that is now CBS Studio Center. Laurel Canyon connects it straight to the Sunset Strip.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Walkable](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#walkable) [Hills & views](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#views) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard)

## At a glance

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles

- **ZIP:** 91604

- **Price level:** $$$$ · Top of market

- **Region:** Valley

- **Good fit if:** You want Valley space with a 15-minute drive to Hollywood.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Studio City

See them on the map →

Studio City runs along Ventura Boulevard at the foot of the Santa Monica Mountains, with the CBS studio lot, a long strip of sushi bars and neighborhood restaurants, a classic jazz club on Cahuenga and trailheads like Fryman Canyon a few minutes up the hill.

26 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

### Parks & outdoors

### Fryman Canyon

Free

3493 Laurel Canyon Blvd (trailhead)

A shady canyon loop with a steady climb and Valley views, popular with dog walkers.

**Do:** Go early; the lot fills fast on weekends.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Fryman+Canyon+3493+Laurel+Canyon+Blvd+%28trailhead%29+Studio+City+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Studio+City+CA)

### Bronson Caves

Free

Next door in [Hollywood Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hollywood-hills) · 2.4 mi · 3200 Canyon Dr

A short, easy walk to the cave used as the Batcave in the 1960s TV show, with a clear view of the Hollywood Sign.

**Do:** Go early for parking, then keep going on the Brush Canyon trail.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bronson+Caves+3200+Canyon+Dr+Hollywood+Hills+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hollywood+Hills+CA)

Free

Next door in [Hollywood Hills](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/hollywood-hills) · 2.4 mi · 8260 Mulholland Dr

A big off-leash dog park in a wooded hollow, with a separate area for small dogs.

**Do:** Take the entrance curve slowly; it's steep.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

1940s and 1950s homes and new builds on the flats, hillside homes south of Ventura, and condos along the boulevard.

**Good fit if**

You want Valley space with a 15-minute drive to Hollywood.

**Think twice if**

You need to be on the Westside every morning.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=studio-city&b=sherman-oaks)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

## Studio City in the news

[All LA news →](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/news)

Real estate

### Netflix buys the Radford Studio Center lot in Studio City for $380 million

The 55-acre, 22-stage lot where Seinfeld and Gunsmoke were filmed drew no bids at Tuesday's foreclosure auction in Pomona, so it went back to the Goldman Sachs-led lenders, and Netflix announced its purchase about an hour later. The price is about a fifth of the $1.85 billion Hackman Capital paid in 2021. ABC7 reports Netflix paid the city's Measure ULA transfer tax on the deal, and the lot will keep running as a working studio.

[November 26, 2026](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/journal/2026-11-26) · Neighborhoods: [Studio City](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/studio-city) · Sources: [ABC7](https://abc7.com/post/netflix-buys-storied-radford-studio-center-city-380-million-variety-reports/20079872/), [The Real Deal](https://therealdeal.com/la/2026/11/24/goldman-sachs-officially-takes-over-radford-studio/), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-24/netflix-buys-seinfeld-la-studio-lot-after-goldman-forecloses)

# Tarzana

Named for Tarzan, with hillside homes and room to spread out.

City of LA ZIP 91356 $$$ · Upper

Get Tarzana listings What's my Tarzana home worth?

What it’s like

Ventura Boulevard for errands and restaurants, Providence Tarzana Medical Center, the rec center, and hillside streets climbing toward Mulholland.

Tarzana is a City of LA neighborhood in the southwest Valley, named after Edgar Rice Burroughs' ranch. Burroughs wrote the Tarzan books.

Living here

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Hillside homes with views south of Ventura, ranch homes north of it, and condos along Ventura and Reseda Boulevards.

**Good fit if**

You want more house and yard for the money than Encino.

**Think twice if**

You need to be over the hill fast every day.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=tarzana&b=encino)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/van-nuys

# Van Nuys

Entry-level houses, real lots and room for an ADU.

City of LA ZIP 91401, 91405, 91406, 91411 $ · Most attainable

Get Van Nuys listings What's my Van Nuys home worth?

What it’s like

Practical and central. Lake Balboa and the Sepulveda Basin are on the south side, Van Nuys Boulevard runs through the middle, and the 405 and 101 are close.

Van Nuys is a City of LA neighborhood in the center of the Valley, home to the Van Nuys Civic Center and Van Nuys Airport, one of the busiest general aviation airports in the country.

## Where to eat, drink and go in Van Nuys

See them on the map →

Van Nuys is the Valley's civic center, home to the Van Nuys Airport and the Sepulveda Basin, with Lake Balboa and the Japanese Garden among the best outdoor spots in the Valley and a long run of family-run restaurants along Victory, Vanowen and Van Nuys Boulevard.

5 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

Go

### Restaurants & cafes

### Cemitas Don Adrian

$

14902 Victory Blvd

A long-running Puebla-style torta shop in a small strip mall.

**Order:** The breaded milanesa cemita.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Cemitas+Don+Adrian+14902+Victory+Blvd+Van+Nuys+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [The Infatuation](https://www.theinfatuation.com/los-angeles/guides/the-best-restaurants-in-the-san-fernando-valley) [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Van+Nuys+CA)

Lunch Cheap eats

### Ay Papa Que Rico

$$

7456 Van Nuys Blvd

A Cuban-inspired spot built around charcoal-grilled chicken, with a pastry case and plenty of seating.

**Order:** Half a chicken with black beans and yellow rice, or a Cubano.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ay+Papa+Que+Rico+7456+Van+Nuys+Blvd+Van+Nuys+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Van+Nuys+CA)

Lunch Dinner Cheap eats

### The Smash Stand

$

16435 Vanowen St

A tiny burger counter tucked beside a liquor store, turning out excellent smash burgers.

**Order:** A double smash and the loaded fries.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=The+Smash+Stand+16435+Vanowen+St+Van+Nuys+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Van+Nuys+CA)

Cheap eats Lunch

### Lake Balboa Park

Free

6300 Balboa Blvd

A big park around a lake with a 1.3-mile loop path, paddle boats and plenty of birds.

**Do:** Walk the loop in the morning; come in spring for the cherry blossoms.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lake+Balboa+Park+6300+Balboa+Blvd+Van+Nuys+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Van+Nuys+CA)

Parks Kids & family Dog-friendly

### The Japanese Garden

$

6100 Woodley Ave

A peaceful formal garden with waterfalls, koi ponds and a teahouse in the Sepulveda Basin. Entry is a few dollars.

**Do:** Check the hours before you go; it keeps limited days.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=The+Japanese+Garden+6100+Woodley+Ave+Van+Nuys+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Van+Nuys+CA)

## The homes, the rules and who it fits

### The housing

Post-war ranch homes on lots of 6,000 square feet and up, many with room for an ADU, plus apartments and townhomes.

**Good fit if**

You want your first house in LA, or a lot with room to add a unit.

**Think twice if**

You want a trendy main street.

Run the numbers [Mortgage](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/mortgage) [Rent vs buy](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/rent-vs-buy) [Transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/compare/?a=van-nuys&b=sherman-oaks)

The rules here

- **Jurisdiction:** City of Los Angeles
- **Transfer tax:** 0.45% city + 0.11% county
- **Measure ULA:** Applies Yes. 4% of the full price over $5.4M, 5.5% at $10.9M and up (2026 thresholds)
- **Rent control:** LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance covers most apartments in buildings built before October 1, 1978
- **Public schools:** Los Angeles Unified (LAUSD)

[Run the transfer tax](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles) [Compare cities](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules)

Rules have exemptions. Confirm for a specific address.

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/woodland-hills

# Woodland Hills

Warner Center, Topanga trails and the Valley's west end.

City of LA ZIP 91364, 91367 $$$ · Upper

Get Woodland Hills listings What's my Woodland Hills home worth?

What it’s like

Warner Center has Westfield Topanga and The Village for shopping and dinner. Topanga State Park trails start in the hills to the south, and Pierce College sits on the north side. Summers run hot.

Woodland Hills is a City of LA neighborhood at the west end of the Valley, next to Calabasas and Topanga.

[Residential streets](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#family) [Yards & space](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#yard) [Quiet](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#quiet)

## Where to eat, drink and go in Woodland Hills

See them on the map →

Woodland Hills sits at the west end of the Valley, with Ventura Boulevard's restaurants along the south side, the Warner Center district's parks and shopping to the north, and the Santa Monica Mountains rising behind it.

4 hand-picked places · Updated 2026-11-26 · Picked from critic reviews and real-people ratings, written in plain English

Go

### Restaurants & cafes

### Prose Kitchen and Bar

$$$

21150 Ventura Blvd

A small, ambitious neighborhood restaurant with a seasonal menu, a tasting menu option and weekend brunch.

**Order:** The four-course tasting menu, or happy hour at the bar.

[Directions ↗](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Prose+Kitchen+and+Bar+21150+Ventura+Blvd+Woodland+Hills+Los+Angeles+CA) Sources: [Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Woodland+Hills+CA)

$$$$

21418 Ventura Blvd

A lively, high-end sushi restaurant with fish sourced from Japan, in an unassuming building.

**Order:** Start with the omakase; come back for the loaded chirashi at lunch.

Free

5800 Topanga Canyon Blvd

A big, shady lawn that hosts free concerts in the summer.

**Do:** Bring a blanket for a summer concert night.

# Prop TE: Palisades fire sellers can skip LA's mansion tax | Nathaniel Grivas

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/prop-te-palisades-mansion-tax-exemption

[Local LA](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods) / [Articles](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#articles) / Laws & Money

# Prop TE: Palisades fire sellers can skip LA's mansion tax

By [Nathaniel Grivas](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/about), REALTOR®
November 25, 2026

Proposition TE passed with about 61% of the vote in the latest count, and the county certifies results by November 27. For homeowners in Pacific Palisades who lost a house or had one damaged in the January 2025 fire, it removes Measure ULA from the sale.

## Who qualifies

The exemption covers residential property damaged or destroyed in the Palisades Fire, sold by the person who owned it on January 7, 2025, the day the fire started. The window runs through January 6, 2030, five years from the fire.

- **Qualifies:** the January 2025 owner selling a fire-damaged house or a burned lot before January 6, 2030.
- **Still pays ULA:** anyone who bought after the fire and resells, sales after the five-year window, and property the fire didn't damage.

LAist's voter guide describes the measure as a one-time refund or exemption. If you already closed a fire-damaged sale and paid ULA, ask the city's Office of Finance whether you can get it back.

## What it saves

Take a burned lot in the Palisades that sells for $6,000,000:

- **Without Prop TE:** 4% ULA on the full price is $240,000, plus about $33,600 in regular city and county transfer tax. Total: about $273,600.
- **With Prop TE:** about $33,600. The regular 0.45% city and 0.11% county taxes still apply.

That's $240,000 back in the seller's pocket on one sale. Above $10.9M the ULA rate is 5.5%, so the savings grow with the price.

## What it means for the market

Original owners can now sell a lot at its real value without the price band near $5.4M working against them. Expect more Palisades lots to trade, and expect buyers to ask whether the seller is the January 2025 owner, since that decides whether ULA is in the deal.

Malibu homes that burned were never subject to ULA, because Malibu is its own city. Brentwood and the rest of the City of LA still pay ULA as usual.

## Before you list

Confirm three things: that you owned the property on January 7, 2025, that the property is on record as fire damaged, and that the sale can close before January 6, 2030. Then run the numbers in the [transfer tax calculator](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax/?city=los-angeles&price=6000000) with and without the exemption.

This is general information, not tax or legal advice. Confirm your eligibility with the City of Los Angeles and your CPA or attorney.

**Sources:** [LAist voter guide to Proposition TE](https://laist.com/news/politics/voter-guides/laist-los-angeles-city-voter-game-plan-proposition-te-november-2026-election-guide); [Daily Bruin, November 15, 2026 results](https://dailybruin.com/2026/11/15/la-voters-set-to-approve-all-local-measures-bringing-infrastructure-tax-changes/); [City Clerk, Proposition TE text](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/election/Measure_TE.pdf); [NBC Los Angeles](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/local/pacific-palisades-measure-ula/3925737/). Dollar figures are calculated from the published rates.

# The 90210 homes that pay LA's mansion tax | Nathaniel Grivas

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/90210-beverly-hills-post-office-city-of-la

[Local LA](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods) / [Articles](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#articles) / Laws & Money

# The 90210 homes that pay LA's mansion tax

By [Nathaniel Grivas](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/about), REALTOR®
November 25, 2026

The hills above Beverly Hills, from Coldwater Canyon to Benedict Canyon and Franklin Canyon, use the 90210 ZIP code. They're in the City of Los Angeles. Locals call the area Beverly Hills Post Office, or BHPO, after the post office that delivers its mail.

The ZIP decides where your mail goes. The city line decides your taxes, your schools and your building rules.

## What changes at the city line

- **Transfer tax:** Beverly Hills charges no city transfer tax, only the county's 0.11%. BHPO pays the City of LA's 0.45% plus Measure ULA on sales above $5.4M.
- **Schools:** Beverly Hills homes feed into Beverly Hills Unified. BHPO homes are in LAUSD.
- **City services:** Beverly Hills has its own police and fire departments. BHPO is covered by LAPD and LAFD.
- **Building rules:** BHPO falls under LA's Baseline Hillside Ordinance, which limits how big you can build on a hillside lot.

## The $267,000 example

Two homes sell for $6,000,000 each, one in the Beverly Hills flats and one up the canyon in BHPO:

- **Beverly Hills:** county transfer tax of about $6,600. That's it.
- **BHPO:** about $6,600 county, $27,000 City of LA, and $240,000 in ULA. Total: about $273,600.

Same ZIP, same price, $267,000 apart. Buyers pricing a BHPO home against Beverly Hills comps should know which side of the line each comp sits on, and sellers near $5.4M should price with ULA in mind.

## Other ZIPs that cross city lines

Other ZIPs cross city lines too. 90069 and 90046 cover parts of both West Hollywood and the City of LA, and 90048 splits between West Hollywood and Beverly Grove. A mailing address that says "Los Angeles" or "Beverly Hills" tells you the post office, so check the parcel itself. LA's [ZIMAS](https://zimas.lacity.org/) shows whether an address is in the City of LA.

See how every city on the Westside handles taxes, rent control and schools in [LA isn't one city](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/la-rules).

**Sources:** [LA County Registrar-Recorder, documentary transfer tax rates by city](https://www.lavote.gov/home/records/property-document-recording/documentary-transfer-taxes); [City of Los Angeles Office of Finance, Measure ULA](https://finance.lacity.gov/faq/measure-ula); [ZIMAS](https://zimas.lacity.org/). Dollar figures are calculated from the published rates.

# Measure ULA in 2026: what LA's mansion tax actually costs a seller | Nathaniel Grivas

Source page: https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/measure-ula-mansion-tax-2026

[Local LA](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods) / [Articles](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/neighborhoods/#articles) / Laws & Money

# Measure ULA in 2026: what LA's mansion tax actually costs a seller

By [Nathaniel Grivas](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/about), REALTOR®
November 25, 2026

If you own a home in the City of Los Angeles worth anywhere near $5 million, Measure ULA is the number that decides your net. Here is how it works for sales closing now, with the math most people skip.

## The 2026 thresholds

For sales closing on or after July 1, 2026, the City of Los Angeles charges:

- **$5.4M or less:** no ULA tax
- **More than $5.4M and under $10.9M:** 4% of the full sale price
- **$10.9M or more:** 5.5% of the full sale price

That sits on top of the regular transfer taxes every LA sale pays: 0.45% to the city and 0.11% to the county. The thresholds move up every July 1 with inflation, so check the current numbers before you price.

## ULA works like a cliff

With income tax, a higher rate only touches the dollars above each line. With ULA, crossing $5.4M by one dollar puts the 4% on the entire price.

- **Sell at $5,400,000:** about $30,240 in city and county transfer tax, no ULA. You net roughly $5,369,760 before other costs.
- **Sell at $5,500,000:** $220,000 in ULA plus about $30,800 in regular transfer tax. You net roughly $5,249,200.

Selling for $100,000 more leaves you about $120,000 worse off.

## The dead zone

Run the numbers forward and there's a price band where a higher offer nets you less than a $5.4M sale:

- **Around $5.4M:** a sale has to reach roughly**$5.63M** just to net what $5.4M nets.
- **Around $10.9M:** a sale has to reach roughly**$11.07M** to net what a sale just under $10.9M nets.

Those figures cover transfer taxes only, before commissions and other closing costs. If your home's real value sits inside one of those bands, pricing strategy matters more than almost anything else you do.

## Where it applies

ULA only applies inside the City of Los Angeles. On the Westside and in the Valley that includes neighborhoods like Brentwood, Westwood, Mar Vista, Venice, Pacific Palisades, Los Feliz, Encino, and Sherman Oaks. Separate cities like Beverly Hills and Santa Monica are outside it, though they set their own transfer taxes. The mailing address can say "Los Angeles" even when the property sits in another city, and the reverse, so check the city line on the parcel before you assume.

## Who pays it

In LA, sellers customarily pay the transfer taxes, but it's a negotiable term in the purchase contract. On a sale near a threshold, who covers it becomes part of the negotiation.

## What changed in 2026

- A statewide initiative that could have rolled ULA back was withdrawn in June 2026, so the tax stays as written.
- The City Council declined to put an exemption for new apartment construction on the ballot.
- LA voters approved Proposition TE on November 3, 2026, with about 61% voting yes in the latest count. It exempts residential properties damaged or destroyed in the January 2025 Palisades Fire from ULA when the January 2025 owner sells within five years of the fire. The county certifies results by November 27. More in [what Prop TE means for Palisades sellers](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/guide/prop-te-palisades-mansion-tax-exemption).

## If you're anywhere near the line

Pull your parcel, confirm the city, and price against net proceeds instead of the headline number. The [transfer tax calculator](https://www.nathanielgrivas.com/tools/transfer-tax) shows the cliff for any price. A sale at $5.4M can beat a sale at $5.6M, and buyers near the line know it too.

This is general information, not tax or legal advice. Talk to your CPA or attorney about your specific sale.

**Sources:** [Haute Living, citing the City of Los Angeles Office of Finance](https://hauteliving.com/realestate/insights/la-measure-ula-mansion-tax-2026); [Seyfarth Shaw](https://www.seyfarth.com/news-insights/measure-ula-remains-in-effect-as-reform-efforts-shift.html); [Hanson Bridgett](https://www.hansonbridgett.com/publication/260701_7087_ula_ordinance_update_june); [LAist](https://laist.com/news/housing-homelessness/los-angeles-city-council-mansion-tax-measure-ula-november-ballot-measure-2026-vote); [LAist on Proposition TE](https://laist.com/news/los-angeles-ballot-measure-palisades-fire-mansion-tax-measure-ula-2026). Dollar figures are calculated from the published rates.
